items.title: 微軟股價Q3飆36.4%！有望創28年最強單季、AI投資回報獲市場肯定
items.title_en: Microsoft Stock Soars 36.4% in Q3! Poised for Strongest Quarterly Gain in 28 Years, AI Investment Returns Earn Market Praise
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 近期重新獲得市場對其雲端與軟體業務的高度評價，隨著投資人對其人工智慧（AI）布局的信心升溫，微軟股價第3季迄今已大漲36.4%，有望創下近30年來最強單季表現。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，截至第3季，微軟股價累計上漲36.4%。道瓊市場數據顯示，若維持目前漲勢，將創1998年第1季以來最佳單季表現。當時微軟股價單季上漲38.5%。
微軟今年初的股價表現則相對疲弱，第1季重挫23.5%，創2008至2009年金融危機以來最差單季表現。
不過，市場近期對微軟各項業務的評價有所提升。StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟越來越受惠於市場「追求優質資產」的資金流向。
他指出，尋求AI曝險的投資人已開始將微軟視為「科技業中品質最高的平台之一」。Lee表示，華爾街近來越來越重視企業能否清楚說明如何將AI商業化，而微軟近期已符合這項條件。
Lee補充，微軟股價目前仍受其「表現極為強勁」的6月季度財報所支撐，該財報進一步增強投資人對微軟AI投資能夠產生回報的信心。
Tigress Financial的Ivan Feinseth也認為，微軟近期股價大漲，反映市場對其AI投資論述的實際證據已有明顯改善。
除此之外，Lee表示，市場的關注焦點正逐漸從「誰擁有最好的AI模型」，轉向其他問題，例如「誰掌握企業環境」，即AI運作所依賴的基礎設施、資料庫與系統。
他指出，微軟作為一個能夠託管各種大型語言模型的平台，具有有利地位，包括OpenAI、Anthropic或其他AI開發商所推出的模型。
此外，微軟上周宣布推出新的Copilot AI助理，也進一步強化一項論點，即該公司有機會將AI營收擴大至傳統軟體訂閱業務之外。
Lee表示：「微軟正將Copilot從生產力助理，發展成更廣泛的企業AI平台。」
他指出，Copilot的功能涵蓋Home、Code及Autopilot。Home是微軟面向個人與家庭用戶的訂閱服務；Code則是供技術與非技術使用者使用的程式設計工具；Autopilot則是一款個人AI助理。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) has recently regained strong market appreciation for its cloud and software businesses, and as investor confidence in its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy warms, the stock has surged 36.4% so far in the third quarter, potentially marking the strongest single‑quarter performance in nearly 30 years.

According to MarketWatch, Microsoft’s share price has risen a cumulative 36.4% through Q3. Dow Jones market data shows that if the current rally continues, it would be the best quarterly gain since Q1 1998, when the stock jumped 38.5% in a single quarter.
Microsoft’s stock performance earlier this year was relatively weak, with a 23.5% drop in Q1, the worst quarterly decline since the 2008‑2009 financial crisis.

However, recent market assessments of Microsoft’s various businesses have improved. StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft is increasingly benefiting from capital flows that are “seeking quality assets.”

He noted that investors looking for AI exposure have begun to view Microsoft as “one of the highest‑quality platforms in the tech sector.” Lee added that Wall Street is paying more attention to whether companies can clearly explain how they will commercialize AI, and Microsoft has recently met that criterion.

Lee further said Microsoft’s stock is still supported by its “exceptionally strong” June quarterly earnings, which have bolstered investor confidence that the company’s AI investments can generate returns.
Ivan Feinseth of Tigress Financial also believes the recent stock surge reflects a clear improvement in the market’s perception of Microsoft’s AI investment narrative.

In addition, Lee said market focus is gradually shifting from “who has the best AI model” to other questions, such as “who controls the enterprise environment,” meaning the infrastructure, data and systems that AI relies on.
He pointed out that Microsoft, as a platform capable of hosting a variety of large language models—including those from OpenAI, Anthropic, or other AI developers—holds a favorable position.

Moreover, Microsoft announced last week the launch of a new Copilot AI assistant, further strengthening the argument that the company can expand AI revenue beyond its traditional software subscription business.
Lee said, “Microsoft is evolving Copilot from a productivity assistant into a broader enterprise AI platform.”

He explained that Copilot’s capabilities span Home, Code, and Autopilot. Home is a subscription service aimed at personal and family users; Code is a programming tool for both technical and non‑technical users; and Autopilot is a personal AI assistant.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭布局要來了！傳10月13日推三款新品
items.title_en: Apple's Smart Home Rollout Is Coming! Rumored to Launch Three New Products on October 13
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)傳將於10月13日推出新一波智慧家庭產品，包括首款配備螢幕的家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，並以新版Siri AI串聯各項功能。這將是蘋果擴大智慧家庭布局的重要一步，也是9月1日接任執行長的特納斯(John Ternus)上任後的一項關鍵產品考驗。
據《彭博》周三(30日)引述知情人士報導，蘋果希望藉由這批新品，切入被公司視為下一波成長機會的智慧家庭市場，同時展示多年投入開發的Siri AI成果。蘋果發言人拒絕置評。

三款新品將登場 家庭中樞成布局核心

這次布局的核心，是代號J490的智慧家庭中樞，配備約6吋方形螢幕，提供桌上型與壁掛型兩種版本。桌上型透過金屬支架連接內建喇叭與麥克風的圓形底座，可手動調整螢幕角度，外觀令人聯想到2002年推出的iMac G4。
裝置配備一顆前置FaceTime鏡頭，沒有後置鏡頭，也未搭載電池，須透過USB-C持續供電。壁掛型版本代號為J491，同樣須接電使用。
新版HomePod mini與Apple TV則將維持現有設計，但升級處理器，以支援Siri更強大的AI模型。HomePod mini還將新增綠色與粉紅色。這將分別是HomePod mini自2020年問世、Apple TV自2022年更新以來，首次推出新版產品。蘋果也計畫日後更新較大型的HomePod喇叭。

辨識家庭成員 提供個人化資訊與智慧控制

家庭中樞最主要的特色，是能辨識不同家庭成員，依據使用者的資料與帳號提供個人化內容。
當使用者走近，裝置可顯示其聯絡人、訊息、行事曆、備忘錄及偏好的App配置；另一名已登錄的家庭成員靠近時，介面便能自動切換。裝置另設訪客模式，隱藏個人資訊。
中樞透過聲音或臉部辨識確認身分，但臉部辨識的可靠度不及iPhone的Face ID。使用者可要求透過iPhone進行額外驗證，辨識失敗時也能由iPhone協助確認身分。昏暗環境下，螢幕周圍可顯示白色環形補光，協助鏡頭辨識使用者。
蘋果設想，消費者可在家中不同位置擺放多台中樞，用來控制恆溫器、門鎖等連網設備，或進行視訊通話、家庭對講、播放音樂及瀏覽iCloud照片。在廚房，使用者也能透過語音查詢食譜、觀看影片，或一邊備餐一邊進行FaceTime通話。
系統介面結合Apple Watch、Apple TV與iPad的設計元素，提供照片輪播、時鐘及天氣等小工具，並內建行事曆、訊息、照片、備忘錄、提醒事項、音樂與Podcast等常用App。

Siri AI延誤拖累上市 蘋果擴大智慧家庭生態系

蘋果原本希望在2024年，隨新版Siri推出家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，但數位助理開發延誤，連帶迫使硬體上市延期。隨著Siri AI本月開始在iPhone、iPad、Mac等產品推出，蘋果終於具備推出智慧家庭新品的條件。
新版Siri採用在Google協助下開發的大型語言模型，可從公開網路取得資訊，並力求提升可靠度，讓使用者更順暢地控制裝置、智慧家電及App。
蘋果過去在智慧家庭市場的布局，落後亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google。2018年推出的初代HomePod銷售受挫，價格較低的HomePod mini雖表現較佳，仍未成為熱銷產品。
如今，蘋果轉向結合AI作業系統、語音助理與螢幕裝置，並擴大HomeKit生態系，與第三方廠商合作開發支援Siri AI家庭平台的新產品。
後續開發項目還包括代號J450、注重隱私的家庭安全攝影機與感測裝置，可偵測使用者位於哪個房間，但不錄製影片；另有搭配機械手臂的進階家庭中樞，配備9吋螢幕，螢幕可360度旋轉。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is rumored to unveil a new wave of smart home products on October 13, including its first home hub with a screen, an updated HomePod mini, and an Apple TV, all linked by a new Siri AI. This marks a major step in expanding Apple’s smart home footprint and a key product test for John Ternus, who took over as CEO on September 1.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 30th, citing insiders, Apple aims to use these new devices to break into the smart home market, which the company sees as its next growth engine, while showcasing years of Siri AI development. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

The three new products will debut, with the home hub at the core of the strategy. Codenamed J490, the hub features a roughly 6‑inch square display and comes in tabletop and wall‑mount versions. The tabletop model uses a metal stand attached to a circular base that houses speakers and a microphone, with a manually adjustable screen angle, reminiscent of the 2002 iMac G4.
The device includes a front‑facing FaceTime camera, no rear camera, and no battery, requiring continuous power via USB‑C. The wall‑mount version, codenamed J491, also needs to be plugged in.

The refreshed HomePod mini and Apple TV will retain their existing designs but receive upgraded processors to support a more powerful Siri AI model. The HomePod mini will also be offered in green and pink, marking the first redesign of the mini since its 2020 launch and the first Apple TV update since 2022. Apple also plans future updates to its larger HomePod speaker.
The hub’s standout feature is its ability to recognize different household members and deliver personalized content based on each user’s data and account.

When a user approaches, the device can display their contacts, messages, calendar, notes and preferred app layout; it automatically switches when another registered family member comes near. A guest mode hides personal information.

Identity is confirmed via voice or facial recognition, though facial recognition is less reliable than iPhone Face ID. Users can request additional verification through an iPhone, and in low‑light conditions the screen shows a white ring of light to aid the camera.

Apple envisions multiple hubs placed around the home to control thermostats, smart locks and other connected devices, as well as to handle video calls, intercom, music playback and iCloud photo browsing. In the kitchen, users could ask for recipes, watch videos, or FaceTime while cooking.

The interface blends design cues from Apple Watch, Apple TV and iPad, offering photo slideshows, clocks, weather widgets and built‑in apps such as Calendar, Messages, Photos, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts.

Siri AI delays have pushed back the launch. Apple originally hoped to release the hub, updated HomePod mini and Apple TV in 2024 alongside a new Siri, but digital‑assistant development setbacks forced hardware delays. With Siri AI now rolling out to iPhone, iPad and Mac this month, Apple finally has the foundation for new smart‑home hardware.

The new Siri leverages a large language model co‑developed with Google, can pull information from the public web and aims to improve reliability, making device, smart‑appliance and app control smoother for users.

Apple’s past smart‑home efforts lagged behind Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US). The original HomePod launched in 2018 struggled in sales, and while the lower‑priced HomePod mini performed better, it never became a bestseller.

Now Apple is shifting to combine AI‑driven OS, voice assistant and screen devices, expanding the HomeKit ecosystem and partnering with third‑party makers to create new products that support the Siri AI home platform.

Future projects include a device codenamed J450—a privacy‑focused home security camera and sensor that can detect which room a user is in without recording video—and an advanced hub paired with a robotic arm, featuring a 9‑inch screen that can rotate 360 degrees.

items.title: 4檔飆股明起抓去關 這3檔近6個交易日漲逾40%  嘉晶、蔚華科處置至10/12
items.title_en: Four Stocks to Be Suspended Starting Tomorrow; Three Have Risen Over 40% in the Past Six Trading Days – Jia Jing, Wei Hua Ke Under Suspension Until Oct. 12
paras: 證交所、櫃買中心今(30)日公告4檔處置股，包括飆股嘉晶(3016-TW)、蔚華科(3055-TW)、大甲(2221-TW)皆自明(1)日起關到10月12日，倚強科(3219-TW)則是處置到10月7日止。除了倚強科採每5分鐘撮合，其餘3檔股票皆為2分鐘撮合交易。
嘉晶遭處置原因為最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達38.94%，且9月30日之週轉率為14.72%。9月29日之最近6個營業日之當日沖銷成交量占最近6個營業日總成交量比率63.84%，且9月29日當日沖銷成交量占該日總成交量比率79.56%。

大甲處置原因為近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達45.66%。最近30個營業日(含當日)起迄兩個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達263.05%。最近60個營業日(含當日)起迄2個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達309.46%。最近90個營業日(含當日)起迄2個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達348.19%當日週轉率達6.97%。當日本益比為65.18、股價淨值比為7.71，且為其所屬產業類別股價淨值比之2.88倍。
蔚華科處置原因為9月30日之本益比為負值，且股價淨值比為14.56。另當日周轉率為14.95%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比4倍以上。
倚強科處置原因為最近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達40.09%。當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大8.14倍。當日周轉率達9.27%。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (Sept. 30) that four stocks will be placed under suspension: high‑flying Jia Jing (3016‑TW), Wei Hua Ke (3055‑TW) and Da Jia (2221‑TW) will be suspended from tomorrow (Oct. 1) through Oct. 12, while Yi Qiang Ke (3219‑TW) will be suspended until Oct. 7. Except for Yi Qiang Ke, which will be matched every five minutes, the other three stocks will be matched every two minutes.

Jia Jing is being suspended because its closing price has risen 38.94% over the past six trading days, and its turnover rate on Sept. 30 was 14.72%. On Sept. 29, the same‑day offset volume accounted for 63.84% of the total volume over the past six trading days, and it made up 79.56% of that day’s total volume.

Da Jia is being suspended because its last‑trade price rose 45.66% over the past six trading days (including today). Over the past 30 trading days (including today), the price rose 263.05% in a two‑day span; over the past 60 trading days, it rose 309.46% in a two‑day span; and over the past 90 trading days, it rose 348.19% in a two‑day span. The turnover rate on the day was 6.97%. The price‑earnings ratio was 65.18 and the price‑to‑book ratio 7.71, which is 2.88 times the industry average for that ratio.

Wei Hua Ke is being suspended because its price‑earnings ratio was negative on Sept. 30 and its price‑to‑book ratio stood at 14.56. The turnover rate that day was 14.95%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times that of its peer group.

Yi Qiang Ke is being suspended because its last‑trade price rose 40.09% over the past six trading days (including today). The day’s trading volume was 8.14 times the average volume of the past 60 trading days, and the turnover rate reached 9.27%.

items.title: 美股多頭行情已接近頂峰？一個罕見信號正發出警訊
items.title_en: Is the US Bull Market Near Its Peak? A Rare Signal Is Raising an Alarm
paras: 儘管美股主要指數持續維持在歷史高點附近，但研究機構 Ned Davis Research（NDR） 警告，表示股票多頭行情可能已接近頂峰。
NDR 指出，衡量市場上漲與下跌股票比率的「市場廣度」正急劇惡化，這種股價高企但市場廣度顯著萎縮的背離現象極為罕見，歷史上多為股市觸頂的前兆。
NDR 分析，標普500指數目前距離8月創下的歷史高點跌幅不到2%，然而過去一周內，指數中僅有不到25%的成分股交易價格高於50日移動平均線，且高於200日移動平均線的股票更是不足45%。
NDR 首席美國策略師Ed Clissold 與資深分析師 Thanh Nguyen 指出，在指數如此接近歷史高點的情況下，這是標普500指數有史以來最糟糕的廣度表現。
NDR 追蹤自1980年以來的數據發現，同時滿足「指數距高點不到3%」、「少於35%成分股高於50日均線」及「少於50%成分股高於200日均線」這三項條件的情況僅出現過6次，過去曾發生於2014年9月與2021年11月的牛市頂峰前夕。歷史經驗顯示，背離出現後，標普500指數通常會在接下來一個月面臨下行偏向，並在大約5個月後觸頂。
Clissold 與 Nguyen 在報告中表示：「絕大多數的市場頂峰前都會出現廣度背離現象，我們嚴肅看待此類技術面警告訊號。」他們補充指出，悲觀觀點認為目前僅靠超大型科技股掩蓋了市場內部的潛在危機；若年末的反彈行情未能修正背離，審慎的做法是適度調降股票部位。
此外，滙豐銀行策略師也指出，隨著債券殖利率急升，市場廣度下滑，反映出美股「引擎蓋下方已遭受嚴重損傷」。
paras_en: Despite US equity indices staying near historic highs, research firm Ned Davis Research (NDR) warns that the bull market may be approaching its peak.

NDR points out that the market breadth – the ratio of advancing to declining stocks – is deteriorating sharply. This divergence, where prices stay high while breadth contracts, is extremely rare and has historically signaled market tops.

NDR notes that the S&P 500 is less than 2% below its August all‑time high, yet in the past week fewer than 25% of its constituents traded above their 50‑day moving average and fewer than 45% were above their 200‑day moving average.

NDR’s chief US strategist Ed Clissold and senior analyst Thanh Nguyen say that, given how close the index is to its record, this represents the worst breadth performance the S&P 500 has ever recorded.

Tracking data back to 1980, NDR finds that the combination of “index less than 3% from its high,” “fewer than 35% of constituents above the 50‑day average,” and “fewer than 50% above the 200‑day average” has occurred only six times, most recently on the eve of the bull‑market peaks in September 2014 and November 2021. Historically, after such a divergence the S&P 500 tends to trend lower over the next month and reach a top roughly five months later.

Clissold and Nguyen write in their report: “A breadth divergence appears before virtually every market peak, and we take such technical warnings very seriously.” They add that the pessimistic view is that the market’s underlying risks are being masked solely by mega‑cap tech stocks; if the year‑end rally fails to correct the divergence, a prudent approach is to modestly reduce equity exposure.
Additionally, HSBC strategists note that soaring bond yields and weakening breadth indicate that the “engine under the hood of US equities has suffered serious damage.”

items.title: 殖利率飆升重擊！垃圾債恐創2022年來最慘單月 投資級債也難倖免
paras: 全球債券殖利率飆升重創固定收益資產，導致美國高收益債與投資級債同步遭遇拋售，正使美國垃圾債走向2022年以來最慘單月表現。
美債殖利率9月大幅上升，長天期殖利率周二(29日)觸及數十年高點，債券價格反向下跌，引發一波廣泛且劇烈的賣壓。在美國市場，「垃圾債」與投資級債券都受到重創。
垃圾債又稱高收益債，之所以能提供較高殖利率，是因為發行這類債券的企業通常比投資級借款人承擔更高風險。這些企業相對現金流背負沉重債務，因此在經濟陷入衰退時，違約風險也較高。

垃圾債ETF 9月跌逾2%創2022年來最慘

美國經濟目前看來仍穩健，這有助於支撐垃圾債市場，但是追蹤美國垃圾級企業債的熱門ETF，本月截至周一累計跌幅都超過2%，預料將創下2022年以來最大單月跌幅。
2022年時，美國聯準會(Fed)為對抗飆升的通膨，正積極升息。如今美國通膨雖然已較2022年高峰大幅下降，但仍穩居於Fed 2%目標之上，促使Fed 9月宣布2023年以來首次升息。
市場交易員預期Fed尚未完成升息循環，這使2年期美債殖利率升至多年高點，較長天期的10年期美債殖利率也升至2007年以來最高水準。
目前投資人關注的最大問題，是利率究竟還會升到多高。
Vanguard資深固定收益客戶投資組合經理Rebecca Venter表示，隨著借貸成本不斷上升，最終壓力可能落在垃圾債等市場風險較高的領域。

投資級債也難倖免 利率才是市場主導力量

不過，近期利率波動對美國投資級固定收益市場的打擊，其實與垃圾債不相上下。
投資級固定收益市場涵蓋美債、抵押貸款證券及企業債等。追蹤美國投資級固定收益市場的Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF(BND-US)，9月截至周一累計下跌2.4%。
這與高收債領域的iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF(HYG-US)及State Street SPDR Bloomberg High Yield Bond ETF(JNK-US)同期的跌幅相近。整體而言，垃圾債今年來的表現仍明顯優於投資級債。
Venter表示：「利率走勢確實是固定收益資產報酬的主要驅動因素。」隨著經濟持續擴張，通膨仍面臨升溫壓力，促使投資人推高債券殖利率。
她也表示，美伊戰爭導致美國油價維持高檔，也存在進一步推升整體通膨的風險。

長天期債券賣壓重 垃圾債反而相對抗跌

與投資級債券市場相比，垃圾債通常存續期間較短，因此在今年這種長天期美債波動特別劇烈的環境下，垃圾債反而在某種程度上成為受益者。
例如，iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF(TLT-US)今年到周一的總報酬率下跌7%，其中9月總報酬率跌4.4%。根據FactSet數據，TLT正走向近期以來最慘單月表現，可能創下自今年7月(重挫4.5%)以來最大跌幅。
Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF則被長天期美債曝險拖累，FactSet數據顯示，9月可能創下2024年10月以來最大單月跌幅。該ETF投資組合截至8月底的平均存續期間為5.7年。

投資人開始尋找長債機會

財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds表示，在美國垃圾債市場中，他偏好品質較高的資產。另一方面，較安全的美債遭遇拋售，也讓他開始關注延長債券存續期間、布局較長天期政府債的機會。
Reynolds表示：「我們一直將10年期美債殖利率5.5%視為可能開始更感興趣的水準。現在殖利率上升的速度，比我們原先預期更快。」

items.title: 亞利桑那州之後再加碼德州？台積電傳評估新投資
items.title_en: After Arizona, Another Push into Texas? TSMC Said to Be Evaluating New Investment
paras: 全球最大晶圓代工業者台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)傳出正評估在美國德州投資，以擴大在美晶片生產布局。
據《路透》周三(30日)引述兩名知情人士報導，相關計畫尚未定案，其中一名消息人士表示，德州潛在投資將是在台積電已承諾投入亞利桑那州的2,650億美元之外，另行追加的投資。
兩名消息人士因未獲授權對媒體發言，要求匿名。台灣媒體本周稍早已引述未具名業界消息人士，率先報導這項動向。台積電未立即回應《路透》的置評請求。
台積電今年7月宣布，將在亞利桑那州再投資1,000億美元，使當地承諾投資總額擴大至2,650億美元，用於興建半導體製造設施。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家當時表示，可能還會再興建四座或更多工廠，涵蓋前段晶圓製造與後段封裝設施。
若計入現有及規劃中的建設，台積電亞利桑那州布局將包括合計12座晶圓製造與先進封裝設施，以及一座研發中心。台積電財務長黃仁昭7月接受《路透》訪問時也表示，公司將持續在美國投資。
paras_en: The world’s largest wafer foundry, TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US), is reportedly assessing an investment in Texas, United States, to expand its chip‑production footprint in the U.S.

According to Reuters on Wednesday the 30th, which cited two sources familiar with the matter, the plan has not been finalized. One source said the potential Texas investment would be in addition to the $265 billion TSMC has already pledged for Arizona.

The two sources, who were not authorized to speak to the media, requested anonymity. Taiwanese media earlier this week had already reported the move, citing unnamed industry insiders. TSMC did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment.

In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion in Arizona, raising the total committed investment in the state to $265 billion for the construction of semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
Chairman and CEO Wei Zhejia said at the time that the company might build four or more additional factories, covering front‑end wafer fabrication as well as back‑end packaging facilities.

Including existing and planned projects, TSMC’s Arizona footprint will comprise a total of 12 wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging sites plus an R&D center. CFO Huang Ren‑zhao told Reuters in July that the company will continue to invest in the United States.

items.title: 看好小型股2027年發力 基金經理人點名2檔金融科技股
items.title_en: Optimistic About Small Caps in 2027: Fund Manager Names Two FinTech Stocks
paras: 大型股明年獲利增速預估放緩，小型股則展現加速追趕的強勁力道。Calamos Investments 投資組合經理人 Brandon Nelson 指出，這般消長為 2027 年小型股的爆發力鋪平道路，並特別點名兩家以智慧手機為核心的金融科技後起之秀。
《MarketWatch》引述 FactSet 的最新數據，分析師預估標普 500 指數成分股今年的加權每股盈餘 (EPS) 成長率達 34.8%，但明年將放緩至 15.1%。相較之下，追蹤羅素 2000 小型股指數的 iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM)，其持股的加權 EPS 預計將從今年的 9.16 美元飆升至明年的 13.69 美元，大幅躍升 49%。

Nelson 掌舵 Calamos Timpani 小型股成長基金 (Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund, CTSIX)，他看好的首家標的是數位銀行 Dave。Dave 的旗艦服務 ExtraCash 專注於提供彈性短期借貸，其核心優勢在於獨家的 CashAI 系統，能進行即時信用評估，完全打破傳統依賴 FICO 評分的限制；此外，Dave 也提供零開戶門檻的數位支票帳戶。
官方數據顯示，Dave 第二季月均活躍交易會員數年增 17%，衝上 308 萬人。
FactSet 調查的分析師普遍預估，Dave 今年營收將年增 32% 至 7.3 億美元，每股盈餘更將暴增 50% 至 57.23 美元。Nelson 強調，相較於傳統大型銀行繁瑣的程序，Dave 大幅簡化了金融服務的使用門檻。
不僅如此，Dave 目前正積極測試基於萬事達卡 (Mastercard, MA) 支付網路的「先買後付」(BNPL) 新服務 Dave Flex，進一步拓展生態圈。
另一家獲青睞的標的 Ethos Technologies，則致力於顛覆傳統保險銷售模式。Ethos 透過智慧手機 App 及 ChatGPT 內建的獨立應用程式，直接串聯人壽保險服務。
Nelson 分析，Ethos 今年 1 月才掛牌上市，對市場而言仍屬於相對新鮮的標的。其商業模式採取「直營 (D2C)」與「通路合作」雙軌並進，吸引了約 1.5 萬名保險業務員加入合作。
這項技術創新不僅極大地壓縮了客戶的核保流程，也大幅縮短了業務員獲取佣金的等待時間。
從財務表現來看，Ethos 第二季營收暴增至 1.9 億美元，呈現翻倍成長。
儘管分析師預估該公司今年每股仍將虧損 2.08 美元，但看好其將在 2027 年迎來轉盈機會，達成每股盈餘 1.06 美元。
雖然以週一收盤價 34.24 美元計算，市場共識目標價 35.63 美元僅有約 4% 的潛在漲幅，但 FactSet 追蹤的 9 位分析師目前一致給予「買進」評等，顯見法人對其長期潛力抱持高度肯定。
paras_en: Large-cap stocks are expected to slow profit growth next year, while small caps are showing strong acceleration. Calamos Investments portfolio manager Brandon Nelson points out that this dynamic sets the stage for a breakout in small caps in 2027, and he specifically names two emerging fintechs centered on smartphones.

MarketWatch quoted FactSet’s latest data, showing analysts estimating that the S&P 500’s weighted earnings per share (EPS) growth this year will be 34.8%, but will slow to 15.1% next year. In contrast, the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM), which tracks the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, has a weighted EPS expected to jump from $9.16 this year to $13.69 next year, a 49% increase.

Nelson steers the Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund (CTSIX), and his first pick is digital bank Dave. Dave’s flagship service, ExtraCash, focuses on flexible short‑term lending, with its core advantage being the proprietary CashAI system that performs instant credit assessment, breaking the traditional reliance on FICO scores; Dave also offers a zero‑fee digital check account.
Official data shows that Dave’s second‑quarter monthly active trading members grew 17% year‑over‑year to 3.08 million.

FactSet’s surveyed analysts generally estimate that Dave’s revenue will grow 32% this year to $730 million, and its EPS will surge 50% to $57.23. Nelson emphasizes that, compared to the cumbersome processes of traditional large banks, Dave dramatically lowers the barrier to financial services.
Moreover, Dave is actively testing a new “buy‑now‑pay‑later” (BNPL) service called Dave Flex, built on the Mastercard payment network, further expanding its ecosystem.

Another favored pick, Ethos Technologies, aims to disrupt traditional insurance sales. Ethos uses a smartphone app and an independent ChatGPT‑built application to directly connect life‑insurance services.

Nelson notes that Ethos only went public in January of this year, making it a relatively fresh name for the market. Its business model combines direct‑to‑consumer (D2C) and channel‑partner tracks, attracting about 15,000 insurance agents to collaborate.
This technological innovation not only compresses the underwriting process for customers but also significantly shortens the time for agents to receive commissions.
Financially, Ethos’s second‑quarter revenue surged to $190 million, showing double‑digit growth.
Although analysts forecast the company will still post a $2.08 loss per share this year, they are bullish that it will turn profitable by 2027, reaching $1.06 EPS.

At a Monday close of $34.24, the consensus target price of $35.63 represents only about a 4% upside, yet FactSet’s nine tracked analysts all give a “buy” rating, reflecting strong institutional confidence in its long‑term potential.

items.title: AI大舉推升擴產需求 欣興以逾百億元拿下新竹湖口普利司通廠區
items.title_en: AI Surge Drives Expansion Demand; Inventec Secures Bridgestone Plant in Hsinchu's Hukou for Over NT$10 Billion
paras: 占地面積達1.9萬坪的新竹湖口輪胎大廠普利司通（Bridgestone）輪胎占地面積達1.9萬坪廠區，今(30)日標售以100.8888億元，由IC載板及PCB廠欣興(3037-TW)拿下。
欣興電子除以持續加碼規劃資本支出，今天再度大手筆加碼買地，布局高階PCB與載板產能擴充需求，上市電子大廠欣興電子再度大手筆加碼產能布局。欣興電子透過公開招標方式，以100.888億元取得位於新竹縣湖口鄉的土地及廠房，總土地面積約1萬9072坪、建物面積約1萬7601坪，成為近期新竹科技產聚集區又一大筆重大交易。。
高階PCB、材料需求急，銅箔基板(CCL)大廠台光電(2383-TW)今年1月底初向遠東新(1402-TW)購入桃園市觀音工業區土地及既有建物，交易總金額約27.8億元，本次購地主要作為未來擴產及產線整體規畫之用。
同時，金像電(2368-TW)在昨日通過79億元新增資本支出，公司指出，也將在台灣桃園地區購置土地興建新廠。
paras_en: The Bridgestone tire plant in Hukou, Hsinchu, covering an area of 19,000 ping, was auctioned today (30th) for NT$100.8888 billion, and was won by IC substrate and PCB maker Inventec (3037‑TW).

Inventec Electronics continues to increase its capital‑expenditure plans, and today made another large land purchase to position for high‑end PCB and substrate capacity expansion. The listed electronics giant again made a big capacity investment. Through a public tender, Inventec acquired land and facilities in Hukou Township, Hsinchu County for NT$100.888 billion, with total land area about 19,072 ping and building area about 17,601 ping, marking another major transaction in the Hsinchu tech cluster.

Demand for high‑end PCB and materials is urgent. Major copper‑clad laminate (CCL) producer Tai Guang Electronics (2383‑TW) at the end of January this year initially purchased land and existing buildings in the Guanyin Industrial Zone of Taoyuan City from Far Eastern New (1402‑TW), in a deal worth about NT$2.78 billion. The land acquisition is mainly for future expansion and overall production line planning.

At the same time, Golden Image Electronics (2368‑TW) approved an additional NT$7.9 billion capital expenditure yesterday, and the company said it will also purchase land in Taoyuan, Taiwan to build a new plant.

items.title: 4檔飆股明起抓去關 這3檔近6個交易日漲逾40%  嘉晶、蔚華科處置至10/12
items.title_en: Four Stocks to Be Suspended Starting Tomorrow; Three Have Risen Over 40% in the Past Six Trading Days – Jia Jing, Wei Hua Ke Under Suspension Until Oct. 12
paras: 證交所、櫃買中心今(30)日公告4檔處置股，包括飆股嘉晶(3016-TW)、蔚華科(3055-TW)、大甲(2221-TW)皆自明(1)日起關到10月12日，倚強科(3219-TW)則是處置到10月7日止。除了倚強科採每5分鐘撮合，其餘3檔股票皆為2分鐘撮合交易。
嘉晶遭處置原因為最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達38.94%，且9月30日之週轉率為14.72%。9月29日之最近6個營業日之當日沖銷成交量占最近6個營業日總成交量比率63.84%，且9月29日當日沖銷成交量占該日總成交量比率79.56%。

大甲處置原因為近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達45.66%。最近30個營業日(含當日)起迄兩個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達263.05%。最近60個營業日(含當日)起迄2個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達309.46%。最近90個營業日(含當日)起迄2個營業日之最後成交價漲幅達348.19%當日週轉率達6.97%。當日本益比為65.18、股價淨值比為7.71，且為其所屬產業類別股價淨值比之2.88倍。
蔚華科處置原因為9月30日之本益比為負值，且股價淨值比為14.56。另當日周轉率為14.95%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比4倍以上。
倚強科處置原因為最近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達40.09%。當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大8.14倍。當日周轉率達9.27%。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (Sept. 30) that four stocks will be placed under suspension: high‑flying Jia Jing (3016‑TW), Wei Hua Ke (3055‑TW) and Da Jia (2221‑TW) will be suspended from tomorrow (Oct. 1) through Oct. 12, while Yi Qiang Ke (3219‑TW) will be suspended until Oct. 7. Except for Yi Qiang Ke, which will be matched every five minutes, the other three stocks will be matched every two minutes.

Jia Jing is being suspended because its closing price has risen 38.94% over the past six trading days, and its turnover rate on Sept. 30 was 14.72%. On Sept. 29, the same‑day offset volume accounted for 63.84% of the total volume over the past six trading days, and it made up 79.56% of that day’s total volume.

Da Jia is being suspended because its last‑trade price rose 45.66% over the past six trading days (including today). Over the past 30 trading days (including today), the price rose 263.05% in a two‑day span; over the past 60 trading days, it rose 309.46% in a two‑day span; and over the past 90 trading days, it rose 348.19% in a two‑day span. The turnover rate on the day was 6.97%. The price‑earnings ratio was 65.18 and the price‑to‑book ratio 7.71, which is 2.88 times the industry average for that ratio.

Wei Hua Ke is being suspended because its price‑earnings ratio was negative on Sept. 30 and its price‑to‑book ratio stood at 14.56. The turnover rate that day was 14.95%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times that of its peer group.

Yi Qiang Ke is being suspended because its last‑trade price rose 40.09% over the past six trading days (including today). The day’s trading volume was 8.14 times the average volume of the past 60 trading days, and the turnover rate reached 9.27%.

高階PCB、材料需求急，銅箔基板(CCL)大廠台光電(2383-TW)今年1月底初向遠東新(1402-TW)購入桃園市觀音工業區土地及既有建物，交易總金額約27.8億元，本次購地主要作為未來擴產及產線整體規畫之用。
同時，金像電(2368-TW)在昨日通過79億元新增資本支出，公司指出，也將在台灣桃園地區購置土地興建新廠。
paras_en: The Bridgestone tire plant in Hukou, Hsinchu, covering an area of 19,000 ping, was auctioned today (30th) for NT$100.8888 billion, and was won by IC substrate and PCB maker Inventec (3037‑TW).

Inventec Electronics continues to increase its capital‑expenditure plans, and today made another large land purchase to position for high‑end PCB and substrate capacity expansion. The listed electronics giant again made a big capacity investment. Through a public tender, Inventec acquired land and facilities in Hukou Township, Hsinchu County for NT$100.888 billion, with total land area about 19,072 ping and building area about 17,601 ping, marking another major transaction in the Hsinchu tech cluster.

Demand for high‑end PCB and materials is urgent. Major copper‑clad laminate (CCL) producer Tai Guang Electronics (2383‑TW) at the end of January this year initially purchased land and existing buildings in the Guanyin Industrial Zone of Taoyuan City from Far Eastern New (1402‑TW), in a deal worth about NT$2.78 billion. The land acquisition is mainly for future expansion and overall production line planning.

At the same time, Golden Image Electronics (2368‑TW) approved an additional NT$7.9 billion capital expenditure yesterday, and the company said it will also purchase land in Taoyuan, Taiwan to build a new plant.

items.title: 挺國家能源轉型！兆豐銀主辦皇昌營造87.81億聯貸 超額認購1.34倍
items.title_en: Supporting the Nation's Energy Transition! Mega Bank Leads a NT$8.781 B Syndicated Loan for Huangchang Construction, Oversubscribed 1.34×
paras: 兆豐金 (2886-TW) 旗下兆豐銀行響應國家能源轉型與重大公共建設，統籌主辦皇昌營造 (2543-TW) 新台幣 87.81 億元聯合授信案，資金將用於支應其承攬台電「協和電廠更新改建計畫－防波堤暨圍堤造地及 LNG 卸收碼頭海事工程」所需相關保證及工程周轉金。本案由兆豐銀行擔任統籌主辦及管理銀行，獲 7 家金融機構踴躍支持，最終超額認購 1.34 倍，顯示銀行團對皇昌營造的工程實績、履約能力及營運前景深具信心。
台灣近年積極推動「增氣減煤」能源政策，政府為兼顧供電穩定、減少空氣污染並落實淨零轉型目標，規劃於基隆協和電廠旁設置第四天然氣接收站，並配合協和電廠更新改建，拆除既有燃油機組，轉型為燃氣複循環機組，以提升北部地區供電韌性與低碳能源供應。本次皇昌營造承攬的海事工程，涵蓋防波堤、圍堤造地及 LNG 卸收碼頭等關鍵設施建置，不僅是第四天然氣接收站的重要工程項目，更是國家能源基礎建設的重要里程碑。

皇昌營造為國內知名綜合營造商，曾參與第三天然氣接收站新建工程及觀塘接收站外推方案工程等重大海事建設，累積豐富大型工程施工經驗與專業技術實力。皇昌營造長年投入各類重大公共工程建設，包含水利建設、橋梁、捷運、社會住宅等大型工程，施工品質及專業能力深受業界肯定。近年受惠於公共建設需求持續成長，截至目前在建工程合約總額已逾新台幣 1600 億元，預計未來數年將陸續進入施工高峰及營收認列階段，展現強勁且穩定的營運成長動能。
除專注工程品質與施工技術外，皇昌營造近年亦積極推動 ESG 永續發展，完成溫室氣體盤查及第三方查證，並持續落實節能減碳、職業安全與永續治理等措施。本次聯貸案亦導入永續連結機制，將企業節水、節電等環境績效與授信條件連結，引導企業持續提升永續治理成效，創造金融與產業共同落實淨零轉型的正向循環。
兆豐銀行長期深耕聯貸市場，積極支持國家重大公共建設及綠色轉型發展，自 2020 年以來已 4 度榮獲亞太區貸款市場公會 (APLMA) 評選為「台灣年度最佳聯貸銀行」，深受國內外機構及企業的高度信賴。未來兆豐銀行將持續發揮金融專業，攜手優質企業，共同支持台灣穩定供電、減碳轉型及經濟永續成長，為國家發展注入長遠動能。
paras_en: Mega Financial (2886‑TW) and its subsidiary Mega Bank are responding to the national energy transition and major public infrastructure by coordinating and leading a NT$8.781 billion joint credit facility for Huangchang Construction (2543‑TW). The funds will be used to provide guarantees and working‑capital for its contract with Taiwan Power Co. on the “Xiehe Power Plant Upgrade – Breakwater, Dike Land‑fill and LNG Terminal Maritime Works.” Mega Bank acts as the lead arranger and manager, with seven financial institutions participating, and the loan was ultimately oversubscribed by 1.34 times, reflecting the syndicate’s confidence in Huangchang’s project track record, execution capability, and outlook.

Taiwan has recently been actively promoting a “more gas, less coal” energy policy. To ensure stable power supply, reduce air pollution and achieve net‑zero goals, the government plans to build a fourth natural‑gas receiving station next to the Xiehe Power Plant in Keelung and, in conjunction with the plant’s upgrade, replace existing oil‑fired units with a gas‑fired combined‑cycle unit, boosting northern Taiwan’s power resilience and low‑carbon energy supply. The maritime works that Huangchang is undertaking—including the breakwater, dike land‑fill and LNG terminal—are key components of the fourth receiving station and a milestone for the nation’s energy infrastructure.

Huangchang Construction is a well‑known domestic integrated builder that has participated in major maritime projects such as the new third natural‑gas receiving station and the offshore extension of the Guantang receiving station, accumulating extensive experience and technical expertise in large‑scale construction. The firm has long been involved in various major public works, including water‑resources projects, bridges, MRT lines and social housing, earning industry recognition for construction quality and professionalism. Benefiting from growing public‑construction demand, its pipeline of projects now exceeds NT$1.6 trillion, and it expects to enter a construction peak and revenue‑recognition phase in the coming years, demonstrating strong and stable growth momentum.

Beyond focusing on construction quality and technology, Huangchang has recently been actively advancing ESG sustainability, completing greenhouse‑gas inventories with third‑party verification and continuously implementing energy‑saving, carbon‑reduction, occupational‑safety and sustainable‑governance measures. The syndicated loan also incorporates a sustainability‑linked mechanism, tying environmental performance such as water‑ and energy‑saving targets to loan covenants, encouraging the company to further improve its ESG outcomes and creating a positive cycle of finance and industry supporting the net‑zero transition.

Mega Bank has long been entrenched in the syndicated‑loan market, actively supporting major national public projects and green‑transition development. Since 2020, it has been named “Taiwan’s Best Syndicated Loan Bank” four times by the Asia‑Pacific Loan Market Association (APLMA), earning high trust from domestic and international institutions and corporations. Going forward, Mega Bank will continue to leverage its financial expertise, partner with quality enterprises, and jointly support Taiwan’s stable power supply, carbon‑reduction transition and sustainable economic growth, injecting long‑term momentum into national development.

items.title: 材料-KY擬斥百億元收購同業瑞商Cerdia 明年躋身10億美元企業
items.title_en: Materials-KY Plans to Spend Over NT$11.7 Billion to Acquire Peer Cerdia, Aiming to Become a $1 Billion Revenue Company by Next Year
paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)展現跨區域、多元化發展的強大企圖心，材料-KY將以增發9.95%股權及2.14億美元現金，收購同業Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) 100%股權，收購總金額約為3.68億美元，約117億元新台幣。材料-KY董事長王克璋今(30)日指出，收購完成後，預估2027年材料-KY將躋身年營收逾10億美元企業
材料-KY對此一收購同業Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) 100%股權，材料-KY預估在2026年年底前完成，2027年完成併表，且將進一步朝「跨洲布局、在地供應、全球協同」發展。
至於2026年下半年的材料-KY營運走勢，董事長王克璋在法說會前接受採訪時表示，對於第三季營收超越第二季，第四季營收超越第三季的先前營運走勢看法，目前維持不變，同時，期待透過收購案，讓市場秩序得以維持，也期待如同2023年營運的榮景。
材料-KY預計今年底前完成收購同業Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) 100%股權，王克璋指出，材料-KY著重在市場秩序恢復與建立，至於材料-KY原規劃在亞洲印尼、非洲埃及甚至在中東阿聯酋設立新廠則暫緩。但王克璋指出，與國際眼鏡框合作成立可回收鏡框新公司也正在規劃中。
生產醋片及絲束的Cerdia成立於1912年，與材料-KY為同業，自2017年自母公司分割後，現由黑石集團旗下私募基金管理，2025年營收爲7.31億美元，材料-KY以總金額3.68億美元的100%股權收購案，包括增加發行9.95%股權進行交換，並加上現金2.14億美元，收購總金額約為3.68億美元。
目前股本9.89億元的材料-KY，在增加發行9.95%股權後，股本將增加為10.98億元，而材料-KY預計在2027年年初在取得相關官方核准後，將完成收購程序。材料-KY指出，本交易完成後，集團營運據點將跨越亞洲、歐洲、北美洲及南美洲。
Cerdia擁有逾百年纖維素材料製造經驗，並於德國設有研發中心。Cerdia員工約1100人，為全球前三大醋酸纖維絲束製造商之一。其產品應用於眼鏡、紡織、美妝及高性能濾材等領域，並拓展至電子、醫療及環保永續材料等新興應用。

材料-KY目前以中國生產基地供應全球市場，並透過製造效率、成本管理及垂直整合建立競爭優勢。Cerdia加入後，集團供應體系將分成兩套系統，Cerdia負責生產醋酸纖維絲束，材料-KY則負責生產紡織材料、眼鏡框、手機殼以及車用電池等原材料，進一步朝「跨洲布局、在地供應、全球協同」發展，提升生產調度、原料配置與客戶服務的彈性。面對關稅、物流及地緣政治變化，跨區域營運布局也可望強化供應鏈韌性，縮短與客戶及市場的距離，並更即時掌握各區域需求。
材料-KY在2026年8月營收10.4億元，月減1.7%，年增20.82%，2026年1-8月營收76.53億元，年減20.91%。材料-KY指出，司持續深化新興市場布局，營運動能穩步回升。
材料-KY 2026年第二季營收27.43億元 ，毛利率40.89%，季減14.69個百分點，年減17.34個百分點，稅後純益7.17億元，季減35.73%，年減57.92%，每股純益0.72元。累計上半年營收55.54億元，毛利率48.06%，年減10.28個百分點，上半年稅後純益18.31億元，年減5.95%，每股純益1.85元。
paras_en: Materials-KY (4763-TW) demonstrated strong ambition for cross‑regional and diversified development. It will acquire 100% of peer Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) by issuing 9.95% new shares and paying US$214 million in cash, for a total purchase price of about US$368 million, roughly NT$11.7 billion. Chairman Wang Ke‑zhang said that after the acquisition, Materials‑KY is projected to exceed US$1 billion in annual revenue by 2027.

Materials‑KY estimates that the acquisition of 100% of Cerdia Holding will be completed by the end of 2026, with consolidation into the group’s financial statements in 2027, and will further pursue a strategy of “cross‑continent layout, local supply, global coordination.”

Regarding Materials‑KY’s operating trend in the second half of 2026, Chairman Wang said in a pre‑earnings‑call interview that his view remains unchanged that Q3 revenue will surpass Q2 and Q4 revenue will surpass Q3, and he hopes the acquisition will help maintain market order and replicate the prosperous performance of 2023.

Materials‑KY expects to finish acquiring 100% of Cerdia Holding before the end of this year. Wang noted that the company is focusing on restoring and establishing market order, and that plans to build new factories in Indonesia, Egypt and the United Arab Emirates have been put on hold. He added that a joint venture with an international eyewear‑frame maker to create a recyclable‑frame company is under planning.

Cerdia, founded in 1912 and a peer of Materials‑KY, was spun off from its parent in 2017 and is now managed by a private‑equity fund of Blackstone. Its 2025 revenue was US$731 million. Materials‑KY will acquire 100% of Cerdia for a total consideration of US$368 million, consisting of a 9.95% share issuance and US$214 million in cash.

Materials‑KY currently has a capital base of NT$9.89 billion; after issuing the additional 9.95% shares, capital will rise to NT$10.98 billion. The company expects to complete the acquisition in early 2027 after obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals. Post‑transaction, the group’s operating sites will span Asia, Europe, North America and South America.

Cerdia boasts more than a century of experience in cellulose material manufacturing and operates an R&D centre in Germany. With about 1,100 employees, it is one of the world’s top three producers of acetate fiber tow. Its products serve eyewear, textiles, cosmetics and high‑performance filter media, and it is expanding into electronics, medical and sustainable‑material applications.

Materials‑KY currently supplies the global market from its Chinese production base, leveraging manufacturing efficiency, cost management and vertical integration for competitive advantage. After Cerdia joins, the group will operate two supply systems: Cerdia will produce acetate fiber tow, while Materials‑KY will produce textile materials, eyewear frames, phone cases and automotive‑battery raw materials, further advancing “cross‑continent layout, local supply, global coordination” to improve production scheduling, material allocation and customer service flexibility. This cross‑regional structure is expected to strengthen supply‑chain resilience amid tariff, logistics and geopolitical shifts, shorten distances to customers and markets, and enable faster response to regional demand.

In August 2026, Materials‑KY recorded revenue of NT$10.4 billion, down 1.7% month‑over‑month but up 20.82% year‑over‑year. For January‑August 2026, revenue was NT$76.53 billion, down 20.91% year‑over‑year. The company said it continues to deepen its presence in emerging markets, with operating momentum steadily recovering.

In Q2 2026, Materials‑KY posted revenue of NT$27.43 billion, gross margin 40.89% (down 14.69 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 17.34 points year‑over‑year), net profit after tax NT$7.17 billion (down 35.73% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.92% year‑over‑year), earnings per share NT$0.72. For the first half of the year, revenue totaled NT$55.54 billion, gross margin 48.06% (down 10.28 points year‑over‑year), net profit NT$18.31 billion (down 5.95% year‑over‑year), earnings per share NT$1.85.

items.title: 正淩估明年AI營收成長1倍 人形機器人、無人機迎放量起飛點
items.title_en: Zhengling Projects AI Revenue to Double Next Year as Humanoid Robots and Drones Reach Take‑off Point
paras: 連接器廠正淩(8147-TW)今(30)日召開法說，經營團隊指出，今年下半年AI、人形機器人及無人機等專案相繼放量，預計明年在新產能加入下，業績可望看到更高的成長，其中，AI營收可望成長1倍。
正淩總經理賴琦憲表示，預期第三季營收將來到高峰，第四季目標持平相同水準，全年維持營收年增3成以上的目標；明年在各項新應用進一步放量下，營收增幅有機會優於今年水準。
其中在AI方面，正淩產品涵蓋散熱、光通訊等應用，去年AI營收比重約1成出頭，預計今年可達約15%，明年將進一步跳升至3成；另外，與信邦 (3023-TW)合作的無人機、人形機器人項目也陸續展開，進入起飛點。
正淩副總劉偉豪進一步指出，今年雖然部分訂單遞延，加上拓展新產品、新應用，導致上半年毛利率不如預期，但下半年起隨著新應用布局逐漸發酵，對後續營運相當有信心。
以正淩前8月產品營收比重來看，連接器從60%提升到69%、電子構裝26%、其他5%，其中電子構裝下半年看到急起直追的表現；若以MATIC五大市場比重來看，醫療30.7%、航太2.9%、交通3%、工業19%、通訊44.3%。
產能方面，新北廠增加400坪空間，人力增加2成，第四季量產，醫療專線認證也通過；彰濱廠精密加工、全自動檢驗產線第四季投產。廣州廠產能增加3成、泰國廠醫療產線第三季量產，光通產品第四季量產。
正淩董事長徐季麟表示，正淩成立40年，從生存、成長與轉型，現在要走向傳承與第二成長曲線；近期交棒卸任的前總經理陳言成，現在是航太子公司董事長，並負責過往公司較弱的併購投資領域，擴大相關布局。
paras_en: Connector maker Zhengling (8147‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (30th). The management team said that AI, humanoid robot and drone projects will ramp up in the second half of this year, and with new capacity added next year, performance is expected to grow even faster, with AI revenue projected to double.

General manager Lai Qixian said the company expects third‑quarter revenue to peak, with fourth‑quarter targets remaining flat, and aims for an annual revenue increase of over 30%. With further scaling of new applications next year, the revenue growth could exceed this year’s level.

In AI, Zhengling’s products cover cooling and optical communication applications. AI revenue accounted for just over 10% of total last year, is expected to reach about 15% this year and jump to 30% next year. In addition, drone and humanoid robot projects in partnership with Xinbang (3023‑TW) are also progressing and entering the take‑off stage.

Vice President Liu Weihao added that although some orders were delayed this year and the expansion into new products and applications lowered the first‑half gross margin, the second half’s new‑application rollout is gaining traction, giving him confidence in future operations.

Based on product revenue composition through August, connectors rose from 60% to 69%, electronic assemblies 26%, and others 5%, with electronic assemblies showing rapid catch‑up in the second half. By MATIC’s five major markets, the split is medical 30.7%, aerospace 2.9%, transportation 3%, industrial 19%, and communications 44.3%.

Regarding capacity, the New Taipei plant added 400 ping of space and a 20% workforce increase, with mass production slated for Q4 and medical‑line certification achieved; the Changbin plant’s precision machining and fully‑automatic inspection lines will start production in Q4; the Guangzhou plant’s capacity grew by 30% and the Thailand plant’s medical line will begin mass production in Q3, with optical communication products slated for Q4 mass production.

Chairman Xu Jilin said Zhengling, founded 40 years ago, has moved from survival, growth and transformation to now focus on legacy and a second growth curve. The recently retired former general manager Chen Yancheng is now chairman of the aerospace subsidiary and oversees the previously weaker M&A and investment areas, expanding related initiatives.

items.title: 智慧能源展10/14登場 聚焦減碳、能源管理解鎖AI淨零新技術
items.title_en: Smart Energy Expo Debuts on Oct 14, Focusing on Decarbonization and AI-Driven Net‑Zero Energy Management Technologies
paras: 由外貿協會與SEMI(國際半導體產業協會)旗下GESA綠能暨永續發展聯盟(GESA)共同主辦的2026「台灣國際淨零永續展」與「台灣國際智慧能源週」，將於今(2026)年10月14日-16日在南港展覽館登場，今年雙展聚焦「減碳創新」、「能源管理」與「ESG永續治理」三大主軸，集結前瞻科技、整合性能源解決方案與淨零轉型關鍵技術，也匯聚台達電(2308-TW)、東元(1504-TW)等台廠參展。
貿協表示，隨著台灣碳費制度進入實質運作，加上歐盟碳邊境調整機制（CBAM）正式上路，碳成本正加速影響企業營運決策，「台灣國際淨零永續展」緊扣全球淨零轉型需求，展出涵蓋因應CBAM、深度節能、碳管理與應用、生物多樣性與氣候韌性、綠電交易、綠色金融、循環經濟及檢驗認證等關鍵技術與服務，協助企業加速接軌國際減碳趨勢。
展覽除了匯聚經濟部、台電、台達電、東元、聯華林德、有成精密、永豐銀行、西門子等眾多政府及指標企業，國際特色展區更集結多國創新能源如日本館匯聚ELIS、LiLz等8家企業，展出微型水力發電、AI與IoT遠端設備監測，以及分散式碳捕捉、利用與封存等技術；加拿大卑詩省館則由6家企業參展，聚焦氫能與電網測試、燃料電池、電解槽及奈米材料等前瞻應用。
隨著AI應用加速擴張，全球電力需求持續攀升。「台灣國際智慧能源周」則聚焦能源轉型與淨零科技，整合「太陽光電」、「風力能源」、「智慧儲能應用」及「多元創能」四大展區，串聯能源開發、儲存、管理到智慧應用，完整呈現智慧能源產業生態系與最新解決方案。
展會攜手太陽光電系統公會、小水力綠能產業聯盟，以及台灣氫能暨燃料電池夥伴聯盟，並集結荷蘭、新加坡、英國、挪威、比利時及丹麥等國際館，匯聚全球能源創新技術與產業資源，加速跨國技術交流與市場鏈結。
其中「淨零未來實戰論壇」呼應本屆展會「Net-Zero in Action」主軸，將探討國際金融永續、供應鏈標準升級、AI算力、能源重組及碳數據治理等面向，而綠色金融也是推動淨零轉型的重要力量之一，深入探討金融市場如何影響企業淨零布局。
另因應 AI 資料中心與高效能運算帶動用電需求快速攀升，展會「旗艦專題暨 Power Next｜微電網與能源管理創新論壇」將聚焦韌性電網、穩定供電與區域電力供給三大主軸，探討能源韌性如何成為支撐 AI 發展與產業競爭力的關鍵基礎。
paras_en: The 2026 “Taiwan International Net‑Zero Sustainability Expo” and “Taiwan International Smart Energy Week,” co‑hosted by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council and GESA – the Green Energy and Sustainable Development Alliance under SEMI – will be held from Oct. 14‑16, 2026 at the Nangang Exhibition Hall. This year’s twin events center on three pillars – “decarbonization innovation,” “energy management,” and “ESG sustainable governance” – gathering forward‑looking technologies, integrated energy solutions and key net‑zero transition technologies, with Taiwanese firms such as Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and TECO (1504‑TW) participating.

The Trade Council noted that as Taiwan’s carbon‑pricing system moves into full operation and the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) comes into effect, carbon costs are rapidly influencing corporate decisions. The “Taiwan International Net‑Zero Sustainability Expo” aligns with global net‑zero transition needs, showcasing technologies and services that address CBAM compliance, deep energy savings, carbon management and applications, biodiversity and climate resilience, green power trading, green finance, circular economy, and testing and certification, helping companies accelerate alignment with international decarbonization trends.

The exhibition brings together ministries, Taiwan Power Company, Delta Electronics, TECO, United Microelectronics Corp., Yucheng Precision, E.SUN Bank, Siemens and many other government and flagship enterprises. The international showcase area features new energy innovators from multiple countries: Japan’s pavilion hosts eight firms including ELIS and LiLz, displaying micro‑hydropower, AI‑ and IoT‑based remote equipment monitoring, and distributed carbon capture, utilization and storage technologies; Canada’s British Columbia pavilion includes six companies focusing on hydrogen, grid testing, fuel cells, electrolyzers and nanomaterials.

With AI applications expanding rapidly, global electricity demand continues to rise. The “Taiwan International Smart Energy Week” concentrates on energy transition and net‑zero technologies, integrating four exhibition zones – solar photovoltaics, wind energy, smart storage applications, and diversified power generation – linking energy development, storage, management and smart use to present a complete smart‑energy industry ecosystem and the latest solutions.

The expo partners with the Solar Photovoltaic System Association, the Small‑Hydro Green Energy Industry Alliance, and the Taiwan Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Partnership, and gathers international pavilions from the Netherlands, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Norway, Belgium and Denmark, consolidating global energy‑innovation technologies and industry resources to accelerate cross‑border technology exchange and market linkage.

The “Net‑Zero Future Practical Forum,” echoing the expo’s “Net‑Zero in Action” theme, will explore international sustainable finance, supply‑chain standard upgrades, AI computing power, energy restructuring and carbon data governance. Green finance, a key driver of net‑zero transition, will be examined in depth to understand how financial markets influence corporate net‑zero strategies.

In response to the surge in electricity demand from AI data centers and high‑performance computing, the expo’s flagship session “Power Next | Micro‑grid and Energy Management Innovation Forum” will focus on resilient grids, stable power supply and regional electricity provisioning, discussing how energy resilience becomes a critical foundation supporting AI development and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: 中華電信榮登《TIME》全球TOP 1%永續企業登台灣電信業之冠  科技創新驅動永續韌性  實力再獲國際高度肯定
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom Ranks Among TIME's Global Top 1% Sustainable Companies, Crowned Leader in Taiwan Telecom Industry; Technological Innovation Fuels Sustainable Resilience, Further International Recognition
paras: 國際知名媒體《TIME》時代雜誌日前公布「2026全球最永續企業」(World"s Most Sustainable Companies 2026)榜單，中華電信(2412-TW)在全球43個國家、20個產業、超過5800家企業中脫穎而出，名列全球TOP 1%，除了連續3年獲選，今年更一舉躍升全球第39名，是臺灣電信業第一，與全球頂尖企業並駕齊驅，彰顯中華電信強勁的永續實力獲得國際高度肯定。
「全球最永續企業」由《TIME》雜誌與國際數據研究機構Statista共同評選，以企業的「承諾與評級」、「揭露與透明度」及「環境與社會實際績效」三大構面、逾20項關鍵指標進行綜合評比。今年中華電信各項指標均表現亮眼，充分展現公司長期深耕永續發展的成果。
董事長簡志誠表示，很榮幸中華電信憑藉完善的永續治理制度、持續深化的永續行動，以及結合AI和ICT科技的創新永續實踐，再度獲得國際高度肯定。面對氣候變遷、AI快速發展及地緣環境變化等全球挑戰，將持續以「數位韌性、智慧賦能、永續未來」三大策略為引領，將永續理念深植企業的日常經營，並發揮科技創新力量，打造更具韌性、智慧的永續未來。

誠信治理、透明揭露  中華電信永續表現深受信賴 

中華電信長期秉持誠信及透明的理念，將永續發展融入企業策略與營運，並持續以國際標準檢視自身表現。公司已連續2年榮獲MSCI ESG Rating最高等級AAA評級、連續3年榮獲CDP氣候變遷評比最高等級A級，展現公司在永續治理及氣候行動上的領先實力。
此外，中華電信為全臺首批、提前一年接軌IFRS S1、S2國際永續揭露準則的企業，率先發布永續相關財務資訊專章，強化全集團在永續相關財務資訊、永續與氣候相關風險與機會的透明揭露，以具體行動獲得投資人、客戶及社會大眾的信任，深化永續發展根基。

AI節能、智慧保育  科技創新助攻永續環境 

在環境永續面向，中華電信積極回應AI時代快速成長的能源需求，具體行動包括引入先進的AI節能技術並結合自主研發的智慧管理方案，透過即時分析行動網路負載、智慧調控基地台運作及離峰動態休眠，在維持網路服務品質的同時，降低能源消耗。2025)年透過AI智慧節能已節省數百萬度電，展現中華電信在通訊服務持續成長之際，運用科技提升能源使用效率、降低環境負荷的具體成果。
中華電信也將科技創新應用於生態保育，運用AI影像辨識、AI聲音辨識及AIoT環境監測等技術，打造國內首創「鳥類水上方舟」智慧保育模式，透過科技即時掌握棲地環境與潛在威脅，守護鳥類與濕地生態環境，讓AI從提升企業營運效率的工具，進一步成為守護自然生態的重要力量。

社會共融  將AI導入通訊，建構防詐第一線 

在社會永續面向，中華電信將AI技術導入通訊服務，建構防詐安全網，有效攔阻數以億計的詐騙訊息與威脅，守護全民數位生活。除了持續強化AI簡訊反詐技術，從國境內到國境外、從商業簡訊到個人多媒體簡訊，中華電信運用AI辨識異常內容及可疑特徵，攔阻詐騙訊息；同時，推出「防駭守門員」、「色情守門員」、「Line Bot AI 防詐隊長」等多項網路資安防護服務，每年平均阻擋 107.7 億次的資安及詐騙威脅。
中華電信也透過數位防詐宣導課程及AI互動體驗，協助高齡長者及弱勢族群提升網路安全意識、數位應用能力及識詐防詐能力，讓創新科技成為守護全民數位安全的力量。
簡志誠強調，永續發展已成為企業核心競爭力的重要基礎，也是企業創造長期價值的關鍵，此次獲《TIME》評選為全球TOP 1%永續企業，不僅是對中華電信長期推動ESG成果的肯定，也凸顯中華電信在國際永續舞台上的強韌競爭力。未來，中華電信將持續以科技創新驅動永續韌性，深化淨零減碳、生態保育與社會共融行動，攜手員工、客戶、夥伴及社會各界，共同實踐「科技向善、永續共好」。
paras_en: Internationally renowned magazine TIME recently released its "2026 World’s Most Sustainable Companies" list. Among more than 5,800 firms across 43 countries and 20 industries, Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) stood out, ranking in the global top 1%. After three consecutive years of selection, the company leapt to 39th place worldwide, the highest among Taiwan’s telecom firms, placing it alongside the world’s leading enterprises and underscoring its strong sustainability performance recognized internationally.

The "World’s Most Sustainable Companies" ranking is jointly compiled by TIME and data‑research firm Statista, evaluating firms on three pillars—Commitment & Rating, Disclosure & Transparency, and Environmental & Social Performance—using over 20 key indicators. This year Chunghwa Telecom excelled across all metrics, fully demonstrating the results of its long‑term dedication to sustainable development.

Chairman Jian Zhicheng said he is honored that Chunghwa Telecom, thanks to its robust sustainability governance system, deepening sustainability actions, and innovative AI‑and‑ICT‑driven practices, has again earned high international acclaim. Facing global challenges such as climate change, rapid AI development, and geopolitical shifts, the company will continue to be guided by three strategies—digital resilience, intelligent empowerment, and a sustainable future—embedding sustainability into daily operations and leveraging technological innovation to build a more resilient, intelligent sustainable future.

Integrity governance and transparent disclosure make Chunghwa Telecom’s sustainability performance highly trusted. The company has long adhered to principles of integrity and transparency, integrating sustainability into its strategy and operations while benchmarking against international standards. It has received the highest MSCI ESG Rating of AAA for two consecutive years and the top CDP climate change rating of A for three consecutive years, showcasing its leadership in sustainability governance and climate action.

In addition, Chunghwa Telecom was among the first in Taiwan to adopt the IFRS S1 and S2 international sustainability disclosure standards a year early, publishing a dedicated sustainability financial information chapter. This enhances group‑wide transparency on sustainability‑related financial data, climate risks and opportunities, earning the trust of investors, customers and the public and deepening the foundation of sustainable development.

AI energy‑saving and smart conservation illustrate how technology drives environmental sustainability. The company actively addresses the growing energy demand of the AI era by deploying advanced AI energy‑saving technologies and proprietary smart management solutions. Real‑time analysis of mobile network load, intelligent base‑station control and off‑peak dynamic sleep modes reduce power consumption while maintaining service quality. By 2025, AI‑driven energy‑saving measures have saved millions of kilowatt‑hours, demonstrating concrete results in improving energy efficiency and lowering environmental impact as communication services expand.

Chunghwa Telecom also applies technological innovation to ecological conservation, using AI image and sound recognition and AIoT environmental monitoring to create Taiwan’s first “Bird Ark” smart conservation model. The system monitors habitats and potential threats in real time, protecting birds and wetland ecosystems, turning AI from a tool for operational efficiency into a vital force for safeguarding nature.

Social inclusion: integrating AI into communications to build the front line of fraud prevention. The company embeds AI into its communication services to construct a fraud‑prevention safety net, effectively blocking billions of scam messages and threats and protecting the public’s digital life. By continuously strengthening AI‑based SMS anti‑fraud technology—both domestic and international, commercial and personal—Chunghwa Telecom uses AI to detect abnormal content and suspicious features, stopping fraudulent messages. It also offers services such as “Anti‑Hack Gatekeeper,” “Pornography Gatekeeper,” and “Line Bot AI Fraud‑Prevention Captain,” averting an average of 10.77 billion cyber‑security and fraud attempts each year.

Through digital anti‑fraud education courses and AI interactive experiences, Chunghwa Telecom helps seniors and vulnerable groups improve their online safety awareness, digital skills and fraud‑prevention abilities, turning innovative technology into a force that protects the digital security of all citizens.

Jian Zhicheng emphasized that sustainable development has become a core foundation of corporate competitiveness and a key to creating long‑term value. Being selected by TIME as a global top‑1% sustainable company not only validates Chunghwa Telecom’s long‑term ESG achievements but also highlights its robust competitiveness on the international sustainability stage. Going forward, the company will continue to drive sustainable resilience through technological innovation, deepen net‑zero carbon reduction, ecological conservation and social inclusion actions, and work together with employees, customers, partners and society to realize “technology for good, sustainability for all.”

items.title: 微軟股價Q3飆36.4%！有望創28年最強單季、AI投資回報獲市場肯定
items.title_en: Microsoft Stock Soars 36.4% in Q3! Poised for Strongest Quarterly Gain in 28 Years, AI Investment Returns Earn Market Praise
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 近期重新獲得市場對其雲端與軟體業務的高度評價，隨著投資人對其人工智慧（AI）布局的信心升溫，微軟股價第3季迄今已大漲36.4%，有望創下近30年來最強單季表現。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，截至第3季，微軟股價累計上漲36.4%。道瓊市場數據顯示，若維持目前漲勢，將創1998年第1季以來最佳單季表現。當時微軟股價單季上漲38.5%。
微軟今年初的股價表現則相對疲弱，第1季重挫23.5%，創2008至2009年金融危機以來最差單季表現。
不過，市場近期對微軟各項業務的評價有所提升。StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟越來越受惠於市場「追求優質資產」的資金流向。
他指出，尋求AI曝險的投資人已開始將微軟視為「科技業中品質最高的平台之一」。Lee表示，華爾街近來越來越重視企業能否清楚說明如何將AI商業化，而微軟近期已符合這項條件。
Lee補充，微軟股價目前仍受其「表現極為強勁」的6月季度財報所支撐，該財報進一步增強投資人對微軟AI投資能夠產生回報的信心。
Tigress Financial的Ivan Feinseth也認為，微軟近期股價大漲，反映市場對其AI投資論述的實際證據已有明顯改善。
除此之外，Lee表示，市場的關注焦點正逐漸從「誰擁有最好的AI模型」，轉向其他問題，例如「誰掌握企業環境」，即AI運作所依賴的基礎設施、資料庫與系統。
他指出，微軟作為一個能夠託管各種大型語言模型的平台，具有有利地位，包括OpenAI、Anthropic或其他AI開發商所推出的模型。
此外，微軟上周宣布推出新的Copilot AI助理，也進一步強化一項論點，即該公司有機會將AI營收擴大至傳統軟體訂閱業務之外。
Lee表示：「微軟正將Copilot從生產力助理，發展成更廣泛的企業AI平台。」
他指出，Copilot的功能涵蓋Home、Code及Autopilot。Home是微軟面向個人與家庭用戶的訂閱服務；Code則是供技術與非技術使用者使用的程式設計工具；Autopilot則是一款個人AI助理。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) has recently regained strong market appreciation for its cloud and software businesses, and as investor confidence in its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy warms, the stock has surged 36.4% so far in the third quarter, potentially marking the strongest single‑quarter performance in nearly 30 years.

According to MarketWatch, Microsoft’s share price has risen a cumulative 36.4% through Q3. Dow Jones market data shows that if the current rally continues, it would be the best quarterly gain since Q1 1998, when the stock jumped 38.5% in a single quarter.
Microsoft’s stock performance earlier this year was relatively weak, with a 23.5% drop in Q1, the worst quarterly decline since the 2008‑2009 financial crisis.

However, recent market assessments of Microsoft’s various businesses have improved. StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft is increasingly benefiting from capital flows that are “seeking quality assets.”

He noted that investors looking for AI exposure have begun to view Microsoft as “one of the highest‑quality platforms in the tech sector.” Lee added that Wall Street is paying more attention to whether companies can clearly explain how they will commercialize AI, and Microsoft has recently met that criterion.

Lee further said Microsoft’s stock is still supported by its “exceptionally strong” June quarterly earnings, which have bolstered investor confidence that the company’s AI investments can generate returns.
Ivan Feinseth of Tigress Financial also believes the recent stock surge reflects a clear improvement in the market’s perception of Microsoft’s AI investment narrative.

In addition, Lee said market focus is gradually shifting from “who has the best AI model” to other questions, such as “who controls the enterprise environment,” meaning the infrastructure, data and systems that AI relies on.
He pointed out that Microsoft, as a platform capable of hosting a variety of large language models—including those from OpenAI, Anthropic, or other AI developers—holds a favorable position.

Moreover, Microsoft announced last week the launch of a new Copilot AI assistant, further strengthening the argument that the company can expand AI revenue beyond its traditional software subscription business.
Lee said, “Microsoft is evolving Copilot from a productivity assistant into a broader enterprise AI platform.”

He explained that Copilot’s capabilities span Home, Code, and Autopilot. Home is a subscription service aimed at personal and family users; Code is a programming tool for both technical and non‑technical users; and Autopilot is a personal AI assistant.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭布局要來了！傳10月13日推三款新品
items.title_en: Apple's Smart Home Rollout Is Coming! Rumored to Launch Three New Products on October 13
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)傳將於10月13日推出新一波智慧家庭產品，包括首款配備螢幕的家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，並以新版Siri AI串聯各項功能。這將是蘋果擴大智慧家庭布局的重要一步，也是9月1日接任執行長的特納斯(John Ternus)上任後的一項關鍵產品考驗。
據《彭博》周三(30日)引述知情人士報導，蘋果希望藉由這批新品，切入被公司視為下一波成長機會的智慧家庭市場，同時展示多年投入開發的Siri AI成果。蘋果發言人拒絕置評。

三款新品將登場 家庭中樞成布局核心

這次布局的核心，是代號J490的智慧家庭中樞，配備約6吋方形螢幕，提供桌上型與壁掛型兩種版本。桌上型透過金屬支架連接內建喇叭與麥克風的圓形底座，可手動調整螢幕角度，外觀令人聯想到2002年推出的iMac G4。
裝置配備一顆前置FaceTime鏡頭，沒有後置鏡頭，也未搭載電池，須透過USB-C持續供電。壁掛型版本代號為J491，同樣須接電使用。
新版HomePod mini與Apple TV則將維持現有設計，但升級處理器，以支援Siri更強大的AI模型。HomePod mini還將新增綠色與粉紅色。這將分別是HomePod mini自2020年問世、Apple TV自2022年更新以來，首次推出新版產品。蘋果也計畫日後更新較大型的HomePod喇叭。

辨識家庭成員 提供個人化資訊與智慧控制

家庭中樞最主要的特色，是能辨識不同家庭成員，依據使用者的資料與帳號提供個人化內容。
當使用者走近，裝置可顯示其聯絡人、訊息、行事曆、備忘錄及偏好的App配置；另一名已登錄的家庭成員靠近時，介面便能自動切換。裝置另設訪客模式，隱藏個人資訊。
中樞透過聲音或臉部辨識確認身分，但臉部辨識的可靠度不及iPhone的Face ID。使用者可要求透過iPhone進行額外驗證，辨識失敗時也能由iPhone協助確認身分。昏暗環境下，螢幕周圍可顯示白色環形補光，協助鏡頭辨識使用者。
蘋果設想，消費者可在家中不同位置擺放多台中樞，用來控制恆溫器、門鎖等連網設備，或進行視訊通話、家庭對講、播放音樂及瀏覽iCloud照片。在廚房，使用者也能透過語音查詢食譜、觀看影片，或一邊備餐一邊進行FaceTime通話。
系統介面結合Apple Watch、Apple TV與iPad的設計元素，提供照片輪播、時鐘及天氣等小工具，並內建行事曆、訊息、照片、備忘錄、提醒事項、音樂與Podcast等常用App。

Siri AI延誤拖累上市 蘋果擴大智慧家庭生態系

蘋果原本希望在2024年，隨新版Siri推出家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，但數位助理開發延誤，連帶迫使硬體上市延期。隨著Siri AI本月開始在iPhone、iPad、Mac等產品推出，蘋果終於具備推出智慧家庭新品的條件。
新版Siri採用在Google協助下開發的大型語言模型，可從公開網路取得資訊，並力求提升可靠度，讓使用者更順暢地控制裝置、智慧家電及App。
蘋果過去在智慧家庭市場的布局，落後亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google。2018年推出的初代HomePod銷售受挫，價格較低的HomePod mini雖表現較佳，仍未成為熱銷產品。
如今，蘋果轉向結合AI作業系統、語音助理與螢幕裝置，並擴大HomeKit生態系，與第三方廠商合作開發支援Siri AI家庭平台的新產品。
後續開發項目還包括代號J450、注重隱私的家庭安全攝影機與感測裝置，可偵測使用者位於哪個房間，但不錄製影片；另有搭配機械手臂的進階家庭中樞，配備9吋螢幕，螢幕可360度旋轉。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is rumored to unveil a new wave of smart home products on October 13, including its first home hub with a screen, an updated HomePod mini, and an Apple TV, all linked by a new Siri AI. This marks a major step in expanding Apple’s smart home footprint and a key product test for John Ternus, who took over as CEO on September 1.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 30th, citing insiders, Apple aims to use these new devices to break into the smart home market, which the company sees as its next growth engine, while showcasing years of Siri AI development. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

The three new products will debut, with the home hub at the core of the strategy. Codenamed J490, the hub features a roughly 6‑inch square display and comes in tabletop and wall‑mount versions. The tabletop model uses a metal stand attached to a circular base that houses speakers and a microphone, with a manually adjustable screen angle, reminiscent of the 2002 iMac G4.
The device includes a front‑facing FaceTime camera, no rear camera, and no battery, requiring continuous power via USB‑C. The wall‑mount version, codenamed J491, also needs to be plugged in.

The refreshed HomePod mini and Apple TV will retain their existing designs but receive upgraded processors to support a more powerful Siri AI model. The HomePod mini will also be offered in green and pink, marking the first redesign of the mini since its 2020 launch and the first Apple TV update since 2022. Apple also plans future updates to its larger HomePod speaker.
The hub’s standout feature is its ability to recognize different household members and deliver personalized content based on each user’s data and account.

When a user approaches, the device can display their contacts, messages, calendar, notes and preferred app layout; it automatically switches when another registered family member comes near. A guest mode hides personal information.

Identity is confirmed via voice or facial recognition, though facial recognition is less reliable than iPhone Face ID. Users can request additional verification through an iPhone, and in low‑light conditions the screen shows a white ring of light to aid the camera.

Apple envisions multiple hubs placed around the home to control thermostats, smart locks and other connected devices, as well as to handle video calls, intercom, music playback and iCloud photo browsing. In the kitchen, users could ask for recipes, watch videos, or FaceTime while cooking.

The interface blends design cues from Apple Watch, Apple TV and iPad, offering photo slideshows, clocks, weather widgets and built‑in apps such as Calendar, Messages, Photos, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts.

Siri AI delays have pushed back the launch. Apple originally hoped to release the hub, updated HomePod mini and Apple TV in 2024 alongside a new Siri, but digital‑assistant development setbacks forced hardware delays. With Siri AI now rolling out to iPhone, iPad and Mac this month, Apple finally has the foundation for new smart‑home hardware.

The new Siri leverages a large language model co‑developed with Google, can pull information from the public web and aims to improve reliability, making device, smart‑appliance and app control smoother for users.

Apple’s past smart‑home efforts lagged behind Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US). The original HomePod launched in 2018 struggled in sales, and while the lower‑priced HomePod mini performed better, it never became a bestseller.

Now Apple is shifting to combine AI‑driven OS, voice assistant and screen devices, expanding the HomeKit ecosystem and partnering with third‑party makers to create new products that support the Siri AI home platform.

Future projects include a device codenamed J450—a privacy‑focused home security camera and sensor that can detect which room a user is in without recording video—and an advanced hub paired with a robotic arm, featuring a 9‑inch screen that can rotate 360 degrees.

items.title: 美股多頭行情已接近頂峰？一個罕見信號正發出警訊
items.title_en: Is the US Bull Market Near Its Peak? A Rare Signal Is Raising an Alarm
paras: 儘管美股主要指數持續維持在歷史高點附近，但研究機構 Ned Davis Research（NDR） 警告，表示股票多頭行情可能已接近頂峰。
NDR 指出，衡量市場上漲與下跌股票比率的「市場廣度」正急劇惡化，這種股價高企但市場廣度顯著萎縮的背離現象極為罕見，歷史上多為股市觸頂的前兆。
NDR 分析，標普500指數目前距離8月創下的歷史高點跌幅不到2%，然而過去一周內，指數中僅有不到25%的成分股交易價格高於50日移動平均線，且高於200日移動平均線的股票更是不足45%。
NDR 首席美國策略師Ed Clissold 與資深分析師 Thanh Nguyen 指出，在指數如此接近歷史高點的情況下，這是標普500指數有史以來最糟糕的廣度表現。
NDR 追蹤自1980年以來的數據發現，同時滿足「指數距高點不到3%」、「少於35%成分股高於50日均線」及「少於50%成分股高於200日均線」這三項條件的情況僅出現過6次，過去曾發生於2014年9月與2021年11月的牛市頂峰前夕。歷史經驗顯示，背離出現後，標普500指數通常會在接下來一個月面臨下行偏向，並在大約5個月後觸頂。
Clissold 與 Nguyen 在報告中表示：「絕大多數的市場頂峰前都會出現廣度背離現象，我們嚴肅看待此類技術面警告訊號。」他們補充指出，悲觀觀點認為目前僅靠超大型科技股掩蓋了市場內部的潛在危機；若年末的反彈行情未能修正背離，審慎的做法是適度調降股票部位。
此外，滙豐銀行策略師也指出，隨著債券殖利率急升，市場廣度下滑，反映出美股「引擎蓋下方已遭受嚴重損傷」。
paras_en: Despite US equity indices staying near historic highs, research firm Ned Davis Research (NDR) warns that the bull market may be approaching its peak.

NDR points out that the market breadth – the ratio of advancing to declining stocks – is deteriorating sharply. This divergence, where prices stay high while breadth contracts, is extremely rare and has historically signaled market tops.

NDR notes that the S&P 500 is less than 2% below its August all‑time high, yet in the past week fewer than 25% of its constituents traded above their 50‑day moving average and fewer than 45% were above their 200‑day moving average.

NDR’s chief US strategist Ed Clissold and senior analyst Thanh Nguyen say that, given how close the index is to its record, this represents the worst breadth performance the S&P 500 has ever recorded.

Tracking data back to 1980, NDR finds that the combination of “index less than 3% from its high,” “fewer than 35% of constituents above the 50‑day average,” and “fewer than 50% above the 200‑day average” has occurred only six times, most recently on the eve of the bull‑market peaks in September 2014 and November 2021. Historically, after such a divergence the S&P 500 tends to trend lower over the next month and reach a top roughly five months later.

Clissold and Nguyen write in their report: “A breadth divergence appears before virtually every market peak, and we take such technical warnings very seriously.” They add that the pessimistic view is that the market’s underlying risks are being masked solely by mega‑cap tech stocks; if the year‑end rally fails to correct the divergence, a prudent approach is to modestly reduce equity exposure.
Additionally, HSBC strategists note that soaring bond yields and weakening breadth indicate that the “engine under the hood of US equities has suffered serious damage.”

items.title: 殖利率飆升重擊！垃圾債恐創2022年來最慘單月 投資級債也難倖免
paras: 全球債券殖利率飆升重創固定收益資產，導致美國高收益債與投資級債同步遭遇拋售，正使美國垃圾債走向2022年以來最慘單月表現。
美債殖利率9月大幅上升，長天期殖利率周二(29日)觸及數十年高點，債券價格反向下跌，引發一波廣泛且劇烈的賣壓。在美國市場，「垃圾債」與投資級債券都受到重創。
垃圾債又稱高收益債，之所以能提供較高殖利率，是因為發行這類債券的企業通常比投資級借款人承擔更高風險。這些企業相對現金流背負沉重債務，因此在經濟陷入衰退時，違約風險也較高。

垃圾債ETF 9月跌逾2%創2022年來最慘

美國經濟目前看來仍穩健，這有助於支撐垃圾債市場，但是追蹤美國垃圾級企業債的熱門ETF，本月截至周一累計跌幅都超過2%，預料將創下2022年以來最大單月跌幅。
2022年時，美國聯準會(Fed)為對抗飆升的通膨，正積極升息。如今美國通膨雖然已較2022年高峰大幅下降，但仍穩居於Fed 2%目標之上，促使Fed 9月宣布2023年以來首次升息。
市場交易員預期Fed尚未完成升息循環，這使2年期美債殖利率升至多年高點，較長天期的10年期美債殖利率也升至2007年以來最高水準。
目前投資人關注的最大問題，是利率究竟還會升到多高。
Vanguard資深固定收益客戶投資組合經理Rebecca Venter表示，隨著借貸成本不斷上升，最終壓力可能落在垃圾債等市場風險較高的領域。

投資級債也難倖免 利率才是市場主導力量

不過，近期利率波動對美國投資級固定收益市場的打擊，其實與垃圾債不相上下。
投資級固定收益市場涵蓋美債、抵押貸款證券及企業債等。追蹤美國投資級固定收益市場的Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF(BND-US)，9月截至周一累計下跌2.4%。
這與高收債領域的iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF(HYG-US)及State Street SPDR Bloomberg High Yield Bond ETF(JNK-US)同期的跌幅相近。整體而言，垃圾債今年來的表現仍明顯優於投資級債。
Venter表示：「利率走勢確實是固定收益資產報酬的主要驅動因素。」隨著經濟持續擴張，通膨仍面臨升溫壓力，促使投資人推高債券殖利率。
她也表示，美伊戰爭導致美國油價維持高檔，也存在進一步推升整體通膨的風險。

長天期債券賣壓重 垃圾債反而相對抗跌

與投資級債券市場相比，垃圾債通常存續期間較短，因此在今年這種長天期美債波動特別劇烈的環境下，垃圾債反而在某種程度上成為受益者。
例如，iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF(TLT-US)今年到周一的總報酬率下跌7%，其中9月總報酬率跌4.4%。根據FactSet數據，TLT正走向近期以來最慘單月表現，可能創下自今年7月(重挫4.5%)以來最大跌幅。
Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF則被長天期美債曝險拖累，FactSet數據顯示，9月可能創下2024年10月以來最大單月跌幅。該ETF投資組合截至8月底的平均存續期間為5.7年。

投資人開始尋找長債機會

財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds表示，在美國垃圾債市場中，他偏好品質較高的資產。另一方面，較安全的美債遭遇拋售，也讓他開始關注延長債券存續期間、布局較長天期政府債的機會。
Reynolds表示：「我們一直將10年期美債殖利率5.5%視為可能開始更感興趣的水準。現在殖利率上升的速度，比我們原先預期更快。」

items.title: 亞利桑那州之後再加碼德州？台積電傳評估新投資
items.title_en: After Arizona, Another Push into Texas? TSMC Said to Be Evaluating New Investment
paras: 全球最大晶圓代工業者台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)傳出正評估在美國德州投資，以擴大在美晶片生產布局。
據《路透》周三(30日)引述兩名知情人士報導，相關計畫尚未定案，其中一名消息人士表示，德州潛在投資將是在台積電已承諾投入亞利桑那州的2,650億美元之外，另行追加的投資。
兩名消息人士因未獲授權對媒體發言，要求匿名。台灣媒體本周稍早已引述未具名業界消息人士，率先報導這項動向。台積電未立即回應《路透》的置評請求。
台積電今年7月宣布，將在亞利桑那州再投資1,000億美元，使當地承諾投資總額擴大至2,650億美元，用於興建半導體製造設施。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家當時表示，可能還會再興建四座或更多工廠，涵蓋前段晶圓製造與後段封裝設施。
若計入現有及規劃中的建設，台積電亞利桑那州布局將包括合計12座晶圓製造與先進封裝設施，以及一座研發中心。台積電財務長黃仁昭7月接受《路透》訪問時也表示，公司將持續在美國投資。
paras_en: The world’s largest wafer foundry, TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US), is reportedly assessing an investment in Texas, United States, to expand its chip‑production footprint in the U.S.

According to Reuters on Wednesday the 30th, which cited two sources familiar with the matter, the plan has not been finalized. One source said the potential Texas investment would be in addition to the $265 billion TSMC has already pledged for Arizona.

The two sources, who were not authorized to speak to the media, requested anonymity. Taiwanese media earlier this week had already reported the move, citing unnamed industry insiders. TSMC did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment.

In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion in Arizona, raising the total committed investment in the state to $265 billion for the construction of semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
Chairman and CEO Wei Zhejia said at the time that the company might build four or more additional factories, covering front‑end wafer fabrication as well as back‑end packaging facilities.

Including existing and planned projects, TSMC’s Arizona footprint will comprise a total of 12 wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging sites plus an R&D center. CFO Huang Ren‑zhao told Reuters in July that the company will continue to invest in the United States.

items.title: 看好小型股2027年發力 基金經理人點名2檔金融科技股
items.title_en: Optimistic About Small Caps in 2027: Fund Manager Names Two FinTech Stocks
paras: 大型股明年獲利增速預估放緩，小型股則展現加速追趕的強勁力道。Calamos Investments 投資組合經理人 Brandon Nelson 指出，這般消長為 2027 年小型股的爆發力鋪平道路，並特別點名兩家以智慧手機為核心的金融科技後起之秀。
《MarketWatch》引述 FactSet 的最新數據，分析師預估標普 500 指數成分股今年的加權每股盈餘 (EPS) 成長率達 34.8%，但明年將放緩至 15.1%。相較之下，追蹤羅素 2000 小型股指數的 iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM)，其持股的加權 EPS 預計將從今年的 9.16 美元飆升至明年的 13.69 美元，大幅躍升 49%。

Nelson 掌舵 Calamos Timpani 小型股成長基金 (Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund, CTSIX)，他看好的首家標的是數位銀行 Dave。Dave 的旗艦服務 ExtraCash 專注於提供彈性短期借貸，其核心優勢在於獨家的 CashAI 系統，能進行即時信用評估，完全打破傳統依賴 FICO 評分的限制；此外，Dave 也提供零開戶門檻的數位支票帳戶。
官方數據顯示，Dave 第二季月均活躍交易會員數年增 17%，衝上 308 萬人。
FactSet 調查的分析師普遍預估，Dave 今年營收將年增 32% 至 7.3 億美元，每股盈餘更將暴增 50% 至 57.23 美元。Nelson 強調，相較於傳統大型銀行繁瑣的程序，Dave 大幅簡化了金融服務的使用門檻。
不僅如此，Dave 目前正積極測試基於萬事達卡 (Mastercard, MA) 支付網路的「先買後付」(BNPL) 新服務 Dave Flex，進一步拓展生態圈。
另一家獲青睞的標的 Ethos Technologies，則致力於顛覆傳統保險銷售模式。Ethos 透過智慧手機 App 及 ChatGPT 內建的獨立應用程式，直接串聯人壽保險服務。
Nelson 分析，Ethos 今年 1 月才掛牌上市，對市場而言仍屬於相對新鮮的標的。其商業模式採取「直營 (D2C)」與「通路合作」雙軌並進，吸引了約 1.5 萬名保險業務員加入合作。
這項技術創新不僅極大地壓縮了客戶的核保流程，也大幅縮短了業務員獲取佣金的等待時間。
從財務表現來看，Ethos 第二季營收暴增至 1.9 億美元，呈現翻倍成長。
儘管分析師預估該公司今年每股仍將虧損 2.08 美元，但看好其將在 2027 年迎來轉盈機會，達成每股盈餘 1.06 美元。
雖然以週一收盤價 34.24 美元計算，市場共識目標價 35.63 美元僅有約 4% 的潛在漲幅，但 FactSet 追蹤的 9 位分析師目前一致給予「買進」評等，顯見法人對其長期潛力抱持高度肯定。
paras_en: Large-cap stocks are expected to slow profit growth next year, while small caps are showing strong acceleration. Calamos Investments portfolio manager Brandon Nelson points out that this dynamic sets the stage for a breakout in small caps in 2027, and he specifically names two emerging fintechs centered on smartphones.

MarketWatch quoted FactSet’s latest data, showing analysts estimating that the S&P 500’s weighted earnings per share (EPS) growth this year will be 34.8%, but will slow to 15.1% next year. In contrast, the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM), which tracks the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, has a weighted EPS expected to jump from $9.16 this year to $13.69 next year, a 49% increase.

Nelson steers the Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund (CTSIX), and his first pick is digital bank Dave. Dave’s flagship service, ExtraCash, focuses on flexible short‑term lending, with its core advantage being the proprietary CashAI system that performs instant credit assessment, breaking the traditional reliance on FICO scores; Dave also offers a zero‑fee digital check account.
Official data shows that Dave’s second‑quarter monthly active trading members grew 17% year‑over‑year to 3.08 million.

FactSet’s surveyed analysts generally estimate that Dave’s revenue will grow 32% this year to $730 million, and its EPS will surge 50% to $57.23. Nelson emphasizes that, compared to the cumbersome processes of traditional large banks, Dave dramatically lowers the barrier to financial services.
Moreover, Dave is actively testing a new “buy‑now‑pay‑later” (BNPL) service called Dave Flex, built on the Mastercard payment network, further expanding its ecosystem.

Another favored pick, Ethos Technologies, aims to disrupt traditional insurance sales. Ethos uses a smartphone app and an independent ChatGPT‑built application to directly connect life‑insurance services.

Nelson notes that Ethos only went public in January of this year, making it a relatively fresh name for the market. Its business model combines direct‑to‑consumer (D2C) and channel‑partner tracks, attracting about 15,000 insurance agents to collaborate.
This technological innovation not only compresses the underwriting process for customers but also significantly shortens the time for agents to receive commissions.
Financially, Ethos’s second‑quarter revenue surged to $190 million, showing double‑digit growth.
Although analysts forecast the company will still post a $2.08 loss per share this year, they are bullish that it will turn profitable by 2027, reaching $1.06 EPS.

At a Monday close of $34.24, the consensus target price of $35.63 represents only about a 4% upside, yet FactSet’s nine tracked analysts all give a “buy” rating, reflecting strong institutional confidence in its long‑term potential.

items.title: 美國國會審查AI資料中心「秘密協定」  亞馬遜、Google與Meta等巨頭承壓
items.title_en: U.S. Congress Reviews AI Data Center “Secret Agreements” – Amazon, Google, Meta and Others Under Pressure
paras: 美國國會對人工智慧資料中心建設的審查正全面升級。眾議院司法委員會民主黨首席議員Jamie Raskin已向亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Google(GOOGL-US)、Meta(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)發函，要求披露與政府官員簽署保密協定(NDA)的狀況及項目細節。
Raskin批評：「當基本條款保持秘密時，居民無法衡量項目的利弊，無法要求官員負責，也無法保護自身資源。」對此，亞馬遜回應表示已不再對政府合作方使用此類保密協定。
保密問題已成為地方反對資料中心的主要原因之一，民眾普遍擔憂設施推高電價並大量消耗水資源。民調顯示有62%的選民支持暫停資料中心開發，且自2024年以來，已有超過1,700億美元的AI資料中心項目因社區反對而遭撤回或停滯。
為加強監督，Raskin與跨黨派議員共同提出《資料中心無秘密法案》(No Secrets for Data Centers Act)，擬限制政府官員透過保密協定隱瞞資訊。
除了透明度爭議，資料中心暴增的用電需求亦引發電網承載與「投機需求」的質疑。德州公共事業委員會主席Thomas Gleeson表示，許多預測需求過高，「很多電力負載屬於投機性質，實際上不會落實。」
前德州公共事業委員會委員Karl Rábago則質疑電力公司推動建置的動機，指出：「電力公司興奮的是服務負載所需投資的資本額，而非服務負載本身。」
公共企業中心資深研究員Advait Arun分析，資料中心「野蠻生長」的預測已無法立足，未來唯有獲得科技巨頭資金直接支持的項目才能順利建置。
paras_en: U.S. Congress is intensifying its review of AI data center construction. House Judiciary Committee Democratic ranking member Jamie Raskin has sent letters to Amazon (AMZN-US), Google (GOOGL-US), Meta (META-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) requesting disclosure of any nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) signed with government officials and details of the projects involved.

Raskin criticized: “When the basic terms are kept secret, residents cannot weigh the pros and cons of a project, cannot hold officials accountable, and cannot protect their own resources.” In response, Amazon said it no longer uses such NDAs with government partners.

Confidentiality concerns have become one of the main reasons local opposition to data centers is growing, as the public worries that facilities will raise electricity rates and consume large amounts of water. Polls show 62% of voters support pausing data‑center development, and since 2024 more than $170 billion in AI data‑center projects have been withdrawn or stalled due to community opposition.
To strengthen oversight, Raskin and bipartisan lawmakers have introduced the “No Secrets for Data Centers Act,” which would limit government officials from hiding information through NDAs.

Beyond transparency disputes, the surge in data‑center electricity demand has raised questions about grid capacity and “speculative demand.” Texas Public Utility Commission Chairman Thomas Gleeson said many demand forecasts are overly high, noting “a lot of the load is speculative and won’t actually materialize.”

Former Texas Public Utility Commission member Karl Rábago questioned the motives of electric utilities pushing these builds, stating: “Utilities are excited about the capital investment required for the service load, not the service load itself.”

Advait Arun, senior researcher at the Public Enterprise Center, analyzed that the once‑predicted “wild growth” of data centers is no longer realistic; going forward, only projects directly funded by tech giants are likely to be built successfully.

items.title: 輝達最大威脅不是AMD、博通？
paras: 輝達(NVIDIA)目前在 AI 資料中心晶片市場獨占鰲頭。儘管超微 (AMD) (AMD-US)與博通(AVGO-US)全力追擊，但外媒《Motley Fool》最新分析指出，對輝達營收與毛利率最具威脅的潛在對手，恐怕不是同業競品，而是其核心大客戶，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)與 Meta (META-US)正全面加速佈局的自研 AI 晶片。
輝達高歌猛進，AMD 與博通難撼動運算地位
輝達當前業績表現依然強勁，其 2027 會計年度第二季資料中心營收年增高達 117%，顯示全球企業對 AI 運算設備的需求熱潮未減。加上輝達維持「一年一世代」的新晶片研發節奏，技術優勢極為顯著。
《Motley Fool》分析，AMD 的 Instinct 系列 GPU 雖然主打性價比、逐步拓展市占，但短期內仍難以撼動輝達在通用型 GPU 市場的霸主地位。博通則聚焦於客製化特殊應用積體電路(ASIC)，產品定位與輝達的通用型 GPU 存在差異，競爭關係相對緩和。
雲端巨頭「去輝達化」，關鍵在於替代而非超越
真正可能重構市場採購結構的，是大型雲端服務商(CSP)的自主研發計畫：

亞馬遜(AWS)：已相繼開發出用於推論與訓練的 Inferentia2 與 Trainium 晶片。
微軟(Microsoft)：今年推出 Maia 200 推論晶片，並積極規劃後續產品 Maia 300。
Meta：近兩年透過內部計畫，已陸續開發出四款自研 AI 晶片。


《Motley Fool》特別強調，大客戶的自研晶片無須在整體性能上全面超越輝達即可構成威脅。只要自研晶片具備更低的總體持有成本(TCO)且供應更穩定，雲端業者就會將部分資料中心工作負載轉向自家產品，進而縮減對外採購輝達硬體的需求。至於微軟未來是否會對外銷售 Maia 300，目前僅屬市場臆測，尚不足以認定其將直接進入通用型 GPU 市場與輝達競爭。
供應吃緊減緩後，定價權與毛利率恐面臨考驗
報導進一步指出，輝達近年居高不下的毛利率，主要源於全球 AI 硬體持續供應吃緊所帶來的強勢定價權。一旦亞馬遜、微軟與 Meta 等三大客戶逐步放量生產自研晶片，並提升內部算力自給率，整體市場供需結構將發生變化，屆時輝達的定價主導力與毛利率表現恐將承壓。
不過，《Motley Fool》也澄清，這項觀點目前仍屬於長期的潛在風險評估，並非輝達當前訂單或毛利率已出現下滑的實據。未來的戰局關鍵，將取決於各大雲端巨頭能否將自研晶片成功進行大規模商業部署，以及這些晶片最終能實質取代多少輝達設備的市場份額。

items.title: 微軟股價Q3飆36.4%！有望創28年最強單季、AI投資回報獲市場肯定
items.title_en: Microsoft Stock Soars 36.4% in Q3! Poised for Strongest Quarterly Gain in 28 Years, AI Investment Returns Earn Market Praise
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 近期重新獲得市場對其雲端與軟體業務的高度評價，隨著投資人對其人工智慧（AI）布局的信心升溫，微軟股價第3季迄今已大漲36.4%，有望創下近30年來最強單季表現。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，截至第3季，微軟股價累計上漲36.4%。道瓊市場數據顯示，若維持目前漲勢，將創1998年第1季以來最佳單季表現。當時微軟股價單季上漲38.5%。
微軟今年初的股價表現則相對疲弱，第1季重挫23.5%，創2008至2009年金融危機以來最差單季表現。
不過，市場近期對微軟各項業務的評價有所提升。StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟越來越受惠於市場「追求優質資產」的資金流向。
他指出，尋求AI曝險的投資人已開始將微軟視為「科技業中品質最高的平台之一」。Lee表示，華爾街近來越來越重視企業能否清楚說明如何將AI商業化，而微軟近期已符合這項條件。
Lee補充，微軟股價目前仍受其「表現極為強勁」的6月季度財報所支撐，該財報進一步增強投資人對微軟AI投資能夠產生回報的信心。
Tigress Financial的Ivan Feinseth也認為，微軟近期股價大漲，反映市場對其AI投資論述的實際證據已有明顯改善。
除此之外，Lee表示，市場的關注焦點正逐漸從「誰擁有最好的AI模型」，轉向其他問題，例如「誰掌握企業環境」，即AI運作所依賴的基礎設施、資料庫與系統。
他指出，微軟作為一個能夠託管各種大型語言模型的平台，具有有利地位，包括OpenAI、Anthropic或其他AI開發商所推出的模型。
此外，微軟上周宣布推出新的Copilot AI助理，也進一步強化一項論點，即該公司有機會將AI營收擴大至傳統軟體訂閱業務之外。
Lee表示：「微軟正將Copilot從生產力助理，發展成更廣泛的企業AI平台。」
他指出，Copilot的功能涵蓋Home、Code及Autopilot。Home是微軟面向個人與家庭用戶的訂閱服務；Code則是供技術與非技術使用者使用的程式設計工具；Autopilot則是一款個人AI助理。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) has recently regained strong market appreciation for its cloud and software businesses, and as investor confidence in its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy warms, the stock has surged 36.4% so far in the third quarter, potentially marking the strongest single‑quarter performance in nearly 30 years.

According to MarketWatch, Microsoft’s share price has risen a cumulative 36.4% through Q3. Dow Jones market data shows that if the current rally continues, it would be the best quarterly gain since Q1 1998, when the stock jumped 38.5% in a single quarter.
Microsoft’s stock performance earlier this year was relatively weak, with a 23.5% drop in Q1, the worst quarterly decline since the 2008‑2009 financial crisis.

However, recent market assessments of Microsoft’s various businesses have improved. StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft is increasingly benefiting from capital flows that are “seeking quality assets.”

He noted that investors looking for AI exposure have begun to view Microsoft as “one of the highest‑quality platforms in the tech sector.” Lee added that Wall Street is paying more attention to whether companies can clearly explain how they will commercialize AI, and Microsoft has recently met that criterion.
