Lee further said Microsoft’s stock is still supported by its “exceptionally strong” June quarterly earnings, which have bolstered investor confidence that the company’s AI investments can generate returns.
Ivan Feinseth of Tigress Financial also believes the recent stock surge reflects a clear improvement in the market’s perception of Microsoft’s AI investment narrative.

In addition, Lee said market focus is gradually shifting from “who has the best AI model” to other questions, such as “who controls the enterprise environment,” meaning the infrastructure, data and systems that AI relies on.
He pointed out that Microsoft, as a platform capable of hosting a variety of large language models—including those from OpenAI, Anthropic, or other AI developers—holds a favorable position.

Moreover, Microsoft announced last week the launch of a new Copilot AI assistant, further strengthening the argument that the company can expand AI revenue beyond its traditional software subscription business.
Lee said, “Microsoft is evolving Copilot from a productivity assistant into a broader enterprise AI platform.”

He explained that Copilot’s capabilities span Home, Code, and Autopilot. Home is a subscription service aimed at personal and family users; Code is a programming tool for both technical and non‑technical users; and Autopilot is a personal AI assistant.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭布局要來了！傳10月13日推三款新品
items.title_en: Apple's Smart Home Rollout Is Coming! Rumored to Launch Three New Products on October 13
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)傳將於10月13日推出新一波智慧家庭產品，包括首款配備螢幕的家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，並以新版Siri AI串聯各項功能。這將是蘋果擴大智慧家庭布局的重要一步，也是9月1日接任執行長的特納斯(John Ternus)上任後的一項關鍵產品考驗。
據《彭博》周三(30日)引述知情人士報導，蘋果希望藉由這批新品，切入被公司視為下一波成長機會的智慧家庭市場，同時展示多年投入開發的Siri AI成果。蘋果發言人拒絕置評。

三款新品將登場 家庭中樞成布局核心

這次布局的核心，是代號J490的智慧家庭中樞，配備約6吋方形螢幕，提供桌上型與壁掛型兩種版本。桌上型透過金屬支架連接內建喇叭與麥克風的圓形底座，可手動調整螢幕角度，外觀令人聯想到2002年推出的iMac G4。
裝置配備一顆前置FaceTime鏡頭，沒有後置鏡頭，也未搭載電池，須透過USB-C持續供電。壁掛型版本代號為J491，同樣須接電使用。
新版HomePod mini與Apple TV則將維持現有設計，但升級處理器，以支援Siri更強大的AI模型。HomePod mini還將新增綠色與粉紅色。這將分別是HomePod mini自2020年問世、Apple TV自2022年更新以來，首次推出新版產品。蘋果也計畫日後更新較大型的HomePod喇叭。

辨識家庭成員 提供個人化資訊與智慧控制

家庭中樞最主要的特色，是能辨識不同家庭成員，依據使用者的資料與帳號提供個人化內容。
當使用者走近，裝置可顯示其聯絡人、訊息、行事曆、備忘錄及偏好的App配置；另一名已登錄的家庭成員靠近時，介面便能自動切換。裝置另設訪客模式，隱藏個人資訊。
中樞透過聲音或臉部辨識確認身分，但臉部辨識的可靠度不及iPhone的Face ID。使用者可要求透過iPhone進行額外驗證，辨識失敗時也能由iPhone協助確認身分。昏暗環境下，螢幕周圍可顯示白色環形補光，協助鏡頭辨識使用者。
蘋果設想，消費者可在家中不同位置擺放多台中樞，用來控制恆溫器、門鎖等連網設備，或進行視訊通話、家庭對講、播放音樂及瀏覽iCloud照片。在廚房，使用者也能透過語音查詢食譜、觀看影片，或一邊備餐一邊進行FaceTime通話。
系統介面結合Apple Watch、Apple TV與iPad的設計元素，提供照片輪播、時鐘及天氣等小工具，並內建行事曆、訊息、照片、備忘錄、提醒事項、音樂與Podcast等常用App。

Siri AI延誤拖累上市 蘋果擴大智慧家庭生態系

蘋果原本希望在2024年，隨新版Siri推出家庭中樞、新版HomePod mini與Apple TV，但數位助理開發延誤，連帶迫使硬體上市延期。隨著Siri AI本月開始在iPhone、iPad、Mac等產品推出，蘋果終於具備推出智慧家庭新品的條件。
新版Siri採用在Google協助下開發的大型語言模型，可從公開網路取得資訊，並力求提升可靠度，讓使用者更順暢地控制裝置、智慧家電及App。
蘋果過去在智慧家庭市場的布局，落後亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google。2018年推出的初代HomePod銷售受挫，價格較低的HomePod mini雖表現較佳，仍未成為熱銷產品。
如今，蘋果轉向結合AI作業系統、語音助理與螢幕裝置，並擴大HomeKit生態系，與第三方廠商合作開發支援Siri AI家庭平台的新產品。
後續開發項目還包括代號J450、注重隱私的家庭安全攝影機與感測裝置，可偵測使用者位於哪個房間，但不錄製影片；另有搭配機械手臂的進階家庭中樞，配備9吋螢幕，螢幕可360度旋轉。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is rumored to unveil a new wave of smart home products on October 13, including its first home hub with a screen, an updated HomePod mini, and an Apple TV, all linked by a new Siri AI. This marks a major step in expanding Apple’s smart home footprint and a key product test for John Ternus, who took over as CEO on September 1.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 30th, citing insiders, Apple aims to use these new devices to break into the smart home market, which the company sees as its next growth engine, while showcasing years of Siri AI development. Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment.

The three new products will debut, with the home hub at the core of the strategy. Codenamed J490, the hub features a roughly 6‑inch square display and comes in tabletop and wall‑mount versions. The tabletop model uses a metal stand attached to a circular base that houses speakers and a microphone, with a manually adjustable screen angle, reminiscent of the 2002 iMac G4.
The device includes a front‑facing FaceTime camera, no rear camera, and no battery, requiring continuous power via USB‑C. The wall‑mount version, codenamed J491, also needs to be plugged in.

The refreshed HomePod mini and Apple TV will retain their existing designs but receive upgraded processors to support a more powerful Siri AI model. The HomePod mini will also be offered in green and pink, marking the first redesign of the mini since its 2020 launch and the first Apple TV update since 2022. Apple also plans future updates to its larger HomePod speaker.
The hub’s standout feature is its ability to recognize different household members and deliver personalized content based on each user’s data and account.

When a user approaches, the device can display their contacts, messages, calendar, notes and preferred app layout; it automatically switches when another registered family member comes near. A guest mode hides personal information.

Identity is confirmed via voice or facial recognition, though facial recognition is less reliable than iPhone Face ID. Users can request additional verification through an iPhone, and in low‑light conditions the screen shows a white ring of light to aid the camera.

Apple envisions multiple hubs placed around the home to control thermostats, smart locks and other connected devices, as well as to handle video calls, intercom, music playback and iCloud photo browsing. In the kitchen, users could ask for recipes, watch videos, or FaceTime while cooking.

The interface blends design cues from Apple Watch, Apple TV and iPad, offering photo slideshows, clocks, weather widgets and built‑in apps such as Calendar, Messages, Photos, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts.

Siri AI delays have pushed back the launch. Apple originally hoped to release the hub, updated HomePod mini and Apple TV in 2024 alongside a new Siri, but digital‑assistant development setbacks forced hardware delays. With Siri AI now rolling out to iPhone, iPad and Mac this month, Apple finally has the foundation for new smart‑home hardware.

The new Siri leverages a large language model co‑developed with Google, can pull information from the public web and aims to improve reliability, making device, smart‑appliance and app control smoother for users.

Apple’s past smart‑home efforts lagged behind Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US). The original HomePod launched in 2018 struggled in sales, and while the lower‑priced HomePod mini performed better, it never became a bestseller.

Now Apple is shifting to combine AI‑driven OS, voice assistant and screen devices, expanding the HomeKit ecosystem and partnering with third‑party makers to create new products that support the Siri AI home platform.

Future projects include a device codenamed J450—a privacy‑focused home security camera and sensor that can detect which room a user is in without recording video—and an advanced hub paired with a robotic arm, featuring a 9‑inch screen that can rotate 360 degrees.

items.title: 美股多頭行情已接近頂峰？一個罕見信號正發出警訊
items.title_en: Is the US Bull Market Near Its Peak? A Rare Signal Is Raising an Alarm
paras: 儘管美股主要指數持續維持在歷史高點附近，但研究機構 Ned Davis Research（NDR） 警告，表示股票多頭行情可能已接近頂峰。
NDR 指出，衡量市場上漲與下跌股票比率的「市場廣度」正急劇惡化，這種股價高企但市場廣度顯著萎縮的背離現象極為罕見，歷史上多為股市觸頂的前兆。
NDR 分析，標普500指數目前距離8月創下的歷史高點跌幅不到2%，然而過去一周內，指數中僅有不到25%的成分股交易價格高於50日移動平均線，且高於200日移動平均線的股票更是不足45%。
NDR 首席美國策略師Ed Clissold 與資深分析師 Thanh Nguyen 指出，在指數如此接近歷史高點的情況下，這是標普500指數有史以來最糟糕的廣度表現。
NDR 追蹤自1980年以來的數據發現，同時滿足「指數距高點不到3%」、「少於35%成分股高於50日均線」及「少於50%成分股高於200日均線」這三項條件的情況僅出現過6次，過去曾發生於2014年9月與2021年11月的牛市頂峰前夕。歷史經驗顯示，背離出現後，標普500指數通常會在接下來一個月面臨下行偏向，並在大約5個月後觸頂。
Clissold 與 Nguyen 在報告中表示：「絕大多數的市場頂峰前都會出現廣度背離現象，我們嚴肅看待此類技術面警告訊號。」他們補充指出，悲觀觀點認為目前僅靠超大型科技股掩蓋了市場內部的潛在危機；若年末的反彈行情未能修正背離，審慎的做法是適度調降股票部位。
此外，滙豐銀行策略師也指出，隨著債券殖利率急升，市場廣度下滑，反映出美股「引擎蓋下方已遭受嚴重損傷」。
paras_en: Despite US equity indices staying near historic highs, research firm Ned Davis Research (NDR) warns that the bull market may be approaching its peak.

NDR points out that the market breadth – the ratio of advancing to declining stocks – is deteriorating sharply. This divergence, where prices stay high while breadth contracts, is extremely rare and has historically signaled market tops.

NDR notes that the S&P 500 is less than 2% below its August all‑time high, yet in the past week fewer than 25% of its constituents traded above their 50‑day moving average and fewer than 45% were above their 200‑day moving average.

NDR’s chief US strategist Ed Clissold and senior analyst Thanh Nguyen say that, given how close the index is to its record, this represents the worst breadth performance the S&P 500 has ever recorded.

Tracking data back to 1980, NDR finds that the combination of “index less than 3% from its high,” “fewer than 35% of constituents above the 50‑day average,” and “fewer than 50% above the 200‑day average” has occurred only six times, most recently on the eve of the bull‑market peaks in September 2014 and November 2021. Historically, after such a divergence the S&P 500 tends to trend lower over the next month and reach a top roughly five months later.

Clissold and Nguyen write in their report: “A breadth divergence appears before virtually every market peak, and we take such technical warnings very seriously.” They add that the pessimistic view is that the market’s underlying risks are being masked solely by mega‑cap tech stocks; if the year‑end rally fails to correct the divergence, a prudent approach is to modestly reduce equity exposure.
Additionally, HSBC strategists note that soaring bond yields and weakening breadth indicate that the “engine under the hood of US equities has suffered serious damage.”

items.title: 殖利率飆升重擊！垃圾債恐創2022年來最慘單月 投資級債也難倖免
paras: 全球債券殖利率飆升重創固定收益資產，導致美國高收益債與投資級債同步遭遇拋售，正使美國垃圾債走向2022年以來最慘單月表現。
美債殖利率9月大幅上升，長天期殖利率周二(29日)觸及數十年高點，債券價格反向下跌，引發一波廣泛且劇烈的賣壓。在美國市場，「垃圾債」與投資級債券都受到重創。
垃圾債又稱高收益債，之所以能提供較高殖利率，是因為發行這類債券的企業通常比投資級借款人承擔更高風險。這些企業相對現金流背負沉重債務，因此在經濟陷入衰退時，違約風險也較高。

垃圾債ETF 9月跌逾2%創2022年來最慘

美國經濟目前看來仍穩健，這有助於支撐垃圾債市場，但是追蹤美國垃圾級企業債的熱門ETF，本月截至周一累計跌幅都超過2%，預料將創下2022年以來最大單月跌幅。
2022年時，美國聯準會(Fed)為對抗飆升的通膨，正積極升息。如今美國通膨雖然已較2022年高峰大幅下降，但仍穩居於Fed 2%目標之上，促使Fed 9月宣布2023年以來首次升息。
市場交易員預期Fed尚未完成升息循環，這使2年期美債殖利率升至多年高點，較長天期的10年期美債殖利率也升至2007年以來最高水準。
目前投資人關注的最大問題，是利率究竟還會升到多高。
Vanguard資深固定收益客戶投資組合經理Rebecca Venter表示，隨著借貸成本不斷上升，最終壓力可能落在垃圾債等市場風險較高的領域。

投資級債也難倖免 利率才是市場主導力量

不過，近期利率波動對美國投資級固定收益市場的打擊，其實與垃圾債不相上下。
投資級固定收益市場涵蓋美債、抵押貸款證券及企業債等。追蹤美國投資級固定收益市場的Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF(BND-US)，9月截至周一累計下跌2.4%。
這與高收債領域的iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF(HYG-US)及State Street SPDR Bloomberg High Yield Bond ETF(JNK-US)同期的跌幅相近。整體而言，垃圾債今年來的表現仍明顯優於投資級債。
Venter表示：「利率走勢確實是固定收益資產報酬的主要驅動因素。」隨著經濟持續擴張，通膨仍面臨升溫壓力，促使投資人推高債券殖利率。
她也表示，美伊戰爭導致美國油價維持高檔，也存在進一步推升整體通膨的風險。

長天期債券賣壓重 垃圾債反而相對抗跌

與投資級債券市場相比，垃圾債通常存續期間較短，因此在今年這種長天期美債波動特別劇烈的環境下，垃圾債反而在某種程度上成為受益者。
例如，iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF(TLT-US)今年到周一的總報酬率下跌7%，其中9月總報酬率跌4.4%。根據FactSet數據，TLT正走向近期以來最慘單月表現，可能創下自今年7月(重挫4.5%)以來最大跌幅。
Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF則被長天期美債曝險拖累，FactSet數據顯示，9月可能創下2024年10月以來最大單月跌幅。該ETF投資組合截至8月底的平均存續期間為5.7年。

投資人開始尋找長債機會

財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds表示，在美國垃圾債市場中，他偏好品質較高的資產。另一方面，較安全的美債遭遇拋售，也讓他開始關注延長債券存續期間、布局較長天期政府債的機會。
Reynolds表示：「我們一直將10年期美債殖利率5.5%視為可能開始更感興趣的水準。現在殖利率上升的速度，比我們原先預期更快。」

items.title: 亞利桑那州之後再加碼德州？台積電傳評估新投資
items.title_en: After Arizona, Another Push into Texas? TSMC Said to Be Evaluating New Investment
paras: 全球最大晶圓代工業者台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)傳出正評估在美國德州投資，以擴大在美晶片生產布局。
據《路透》周三(30日)引述兩名知情人士報導，相關計畫尚未定案，其中一名消息人士表示，德州潛在投資將是在台積電已承諾投入亞利桑那州的2,650億美元之外，另行追加的投資。
兩名消息人士因未獲授權對媒體發言，要求匿名。台灣媒體本周稍早已引述未具名業界消息人士，率先報導這項動向。台積電未立即回應《路透》的置評請求。
台積電今年7月宣布，將在亞利桑那州再投資1,000億美元，使當地承諾投資總額擴大至2,650億美元，用於興建半導體製造設施。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家當時表示，可能還會再興建四座或更多工廠，涵蓋前段晶圓製造與後段封裝設施。
若計入現有及規劃中的建設，台積電亞利桑那州布局將包括合計12座晶圓製造與先進封裝設施，以及一座研發中心。台積電財務長黃仁昭7月接受《路透》訪問時也表示，公司將持續在美國投資。
paras_en: The world’s largest wafer foundry, TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US), is reportedly assessing an investment in Texas, United States, to expand its chip‑production footprint in the U.S.

According to Reuters on Wednesday the 30th, which cited two sources familiar with the matter, the plan has not been finalized. One source said the potential Texas investment would be in addition to the $265 billion TSMC has already pledged for Arizona.

The two sources, who were not authorized to speak to the media, requested anonymity. Taiwanese media earlier this week had already reported the move, citing unnamed industry insiders. TSMC did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment.

In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion in Arizona, raising the total committed investment in the state to $265 billion for the construction of semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
Chairman and CEO Wei Zhejia said at the time that the company might build four or more additional factories, covering front‑end wafer fabrication as well as back‑end packaging facilities.

Including existing and planned projects, TSMC’s Arizona footprint will comprise a total of 12 wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging sites plus an R&D center. CFO Huang Ren‑zhao told Reuters in July that the company will continue to invest in the United States.

items.title: 看好小型股2027年發力 基金經理人點名2檔金融科技股
items.title_en: Optimistic About Small Caps in 2027: Fund Manager Names Two FinTech Stocks
paras: 大型股明年獲利增速預估放緩，小型股則展現加速追趕的強勁力道。Calamos Investments 投資組合經理人 Brandon Nelson 指出，這般消長為 2027 年小型股的爆發力鋪平道路，並特別點名兩家以智慧手機為核心的金融科技後起之秀。
《MarketWatch》引述 FactSet 的最新數據，分析師預估標普 500 指數成分股今年的加權每股盈餘 (EPS) 成長率達 34.8%，但明年將放緩至 15.1%。相較之下，追蹤羅素 2000 小型股指數的 iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM)，其持股的加權 EPS 預計將從今年的 9.16 美元飆升至明年的 13.69 美元，大幅躍升 49%。

Nelson 掌舵 Calamos Timpani 小型股成長基金 (Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund, CTSIX)，他看好的首家標的是數位銀行 Dave。Dave 的旗艦服務 ExtraCash 專注於提供彈性短期借貸，其核心優勢在於獨家的 CashAI 系統，能進行即時信用評估，完全打破傳統依賴 FICO 評分的限制；此外，Dave 也提供零開戶門檻的數位支票帳戶。
官方數據顯示，Dave 第二季月均活躍交易會員數年增 17%，衝上 308 萬人。
FactSet 調查的分析師普遍預估，Dave 今年營收將年增 32% 至 7.3 億美元，每股盈餘更將暴增 50% 至 57.23 美元。Nelson 強調，相較於傳統大型銀行繁瑣的程序，Dave 大幅簡化了金融服務的使用門檻。
不僅如此，Dave 目前正積極測試基於萬事達卡 (Mastercard, MA) 支付網路的「先買後付」(BNPL) 新服務 Dave Flex，進一步拓展生態圈。
另一家獲青睞的標的 Ethos Technologies，則致力於顛覆傳統保險銷售模式。Ethos 透過智慧手機 App 及 ChatGPT 內建的獨立應用程式，直接串聯人壽保險服務。
Nelson 分析，Ethos 今年 1 月才掛牌上市，對市場而言仍屬於相對新鮮的標的。其商業模式採取「直營 (D2C)」與「通路合作」雙軌並進，吸引了約 1.5 萬名保險業務員加入合作。
這項技術創新不僅極大地壓縮了客戶的核保流程，也大幅縮短了業務員獲取佣金的等待時間。
從財務表現來看，Ethos 第二季營收暴增至 1.9 億美元，呈現翻倍成長。
儘管分析師預估該公司今年每股仍將虧損 2.08 美元，但看好其將在 2027 年迎來轉盈機會，達成每股盈餘 1.06 美元。
雖然以週一收盤價 34.24 美元計算，市場共識目標價 35.63 美元僅有約 4% 的潛在漲幅，但 FactSet 追蹤的 9 位分析師目前一致給予「買進」評等，顯見法人對其長期潛力抱持高度肯定。
paras_en: Large-cap stocks are expected to slow profit growth next year, while small caps are showing strong acceleration. Calamos Investments portfolio manager Brandon Nelson points out that this dynamic sets the stage for a breakout in small caps in 2027, and he specifically names two emerging fintechs centered on smartphones.

MarketWatch quoted FactSet’s latest data, showing analysts estimating that the S&P 500’s weighted earnings per share (EPS) growth this year will be 34.8%, but will slow to 15.1% next year. In contrast, the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM), which tracks the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, has a weighted EPS expected to jump from $9.16 this year to $13.69 next year, a 49% increase.

Nelson steers the Calamos Timpani Small Cap Growth Fund (CTSIX), and his first pick is digital bank Dave. Dave’s flagship service, ExtraCash, focuses on flexible short‑term lending, with its core advantage being the proprietary CashAI system that performs instant credit assessment, breaking the traditional reliance on FICO scores; Dave also offers a zero‑fee digital check account.
Official data shows that Dave’s second‑quarter monthly active trading members grew 17% year‑over‑year to 3.08 million.

FactSet’s surveyed analysts generally estimate that Dave’s revenue will grow 32% this year to $730 million, and its EPS will surge 50% to $57.23. Nelson emphasizes that, compared to the cumbersome processes of traditional large banks, Dave dramatically lowers the barrier to financial services.
Moreover, Dave is actively testing a new “buy‑now‑pay‑later” (BNPL) service called Dave Flex, built on the Mastercard payment network, further expanding its ecosystem.

Another favored pick, Ethos Technologies, aims to disrupt traditional insurance sales. Ethos uses a smartphone app and an independent ChatGPT‑built application to directly connect life‑insurance services.

Nelson notes that Ethos only went public in January of this year, making it a relatively fresh name for the market. Its business model combines direct‑to‑consumer (D2C) and channel‑partner tracks, attracting about 15,000 insurance agents to collaborate.
This technological innovation not only compresses the underwriting process for customers but also significantly shortens the time for agents to receive commissions.
Financially, Ethos’s second‑quarter revenue surged to $190 million, showing double‑digit growth.
Although analysts forecast the company will still post a $2.08 loss per share this year, they are bullish that it will turn profitable by 2027, reaching $1.06 EPS.

At a Monday close of $34.24, the consensus target price of $35.63 represents only about a 4% upside, yet FactSet’s nine tracked analysts all give a “buy” rating, reflecting strong institutional confidence in its long‑term potential.

items.title: 美國國會審查AI資料中心「秘密協定」  亞馬遜、Google與Meta等巨頭承壓
items.title_en: U.S. Congress Reviews AI Data Center “Secret Agreements” – Amazon, Google, Meta and Others Under Pressure
paras: 美國國會對人工智慧資料中心建設的審查正全面升級。眾議院司法委員會民主黨首席議員Jamie Raskin已向亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Google(GOOGL-US)、Meta(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)發函，要求披露與政府官員簽署保密協定(NDA)的狀況及項目細節。
Raskin批評：「當基本條款保持秘密時，居民無法衡量項目的利弊，無法要求官員負責，也無法保護自身資源。」對此，亞馬遜回應表示已不再對政府合作方使用此類保密協定。
保密問題已成為地方反對資料中心的主要原因之一，民眾普遍擔憂設施推高電價並大量消耗水資源。民調顯示有62%的選民支持暫停資料中心開發，且自2024年以來，已有超過1,700億美元的AI資料中心項目因社區反對而遭撤回或停滯。
為加強監督，Raskin與跨黨派議員共同提出《資料中心無秘密法案》(No Secrets for Data Centers Act)，擬限制政府官員透過保密協定隱瞞資訊。
除了透明度爭議，資料中心暴增的用電需求亦引發電網承載與「投機需求」的質疑。德州公共事業委員會主席Thomas Gleeson表示，許多預測需求過高，「很多電力負載屬於投機性質，實際上不會落實。」
前德州公共事業委員會委員Karl Rábago則質疑電力公司推動建置的動機，指出：「電力公司興奮的是服務負載所需投資的資本額，而非服務負載本身。」
公共企業中心資深研究員Advait Arun分析，資料中心「野蠻生長」的預測已無法立足，未來唯有獲得科技巨頭資金直接支持的項目才能順利建置。
paras_en: U.S. Congress is intensifying its review of AI data center construction. House Judiciary Committee Democratic ranking member Jamie Raskin has sent letters to Amazon (AMZN-US), Google (GOOGL-US), Meta (META-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) requesting disclosure of any nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) signed with government officials and details of the projects involved.

Raskin criticized: “When the basic terms are kept secret, residents cannot weigh the pros and cons of a project, cannot hold officials accountable, and cannot protect their own resources.” In response, Amazon said it no longer uses such NDAs with government partners.

Confidentiality concerns have become one of the main reasons local opposition to data centers is growing, as the public worries that facilities will raise electricity rates and consume large amounts of water. Polls show 62% of voters support pausing data‑center development, and since 2024 more than $170 billion in AI data‑center projects have been withdrawn or stalled due to community opposition.
To strengthen oversight, Raskin and bipartisan lawmakers have introduced the “No Secrets for Data Centers Act,” which would limit government officials from hiding information through NDAs.

Beyond transparency disputes, the surge in data‑center electricity demand has raised questions about grid capacity and “speculative demand.” Texas Public Utility Commission Chairman Thomas Gleeson said many demand forecasts are overly high, noting “a lot of the load is speculative and won’t actually materialize.”

Former Texas Public Utility Commission member Karl Rábago questioned the motives of electric utilities pushing these builds, stating: “Utilities are excited about the capital investment required for the service load, not the service load itself.”

Advait Arun, senior researcher at the Public Enterprise Center, analyzed that the once‑predicted “wild growth” of data centers is no longer realistic; going forward, only projects directly funded by tech giants are likely to be built successfully.

items.title: 輝達最大威脅不是AMD、博通？
paras: 輝達(NVIDIA)目前在 AI 資料中心晶片市場獨占鰲頭。儘管超微 (AMD) (AMD-US)與博通(AVGO-US)全力追擊，但外媒《Motley Fool》最新分析指出，對輝達營收與毛利率最具威脅的潛在對手，恐怕不是同業競品，而是其核心大客戶，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)與 Meta (META-US)正全面加速佈局的自研 AI 晶片。
輝達高歌猛進，AMD 與博通難撼動運算地位
輝達當前業績表現依然強勁，其 2027 會計年度第二季資料中心營收年增高達 117%，顯示全球企業對 AI 運算設備的需求熱潮未減。加上輝達維持「一年一世代」的新晶片研發節奏，技術優勢極為顯著。
《Motley Fool》分析，AMD 的 Instinct 系列 GPU 雖然主打性價比、逐步拓展市占，但短期內仍難以撼動輝達在通用型 GPU 市場的霸主地位。博通則聚焦於客製化特殊應用積體電路(ASIC)，產品定位與輝達的通用型 GPU 存在差異，競爭關係相對緩和。
雲端巨頭「去輝達化」，關鍵在於替代而非超越
真正可能重構市場採購結構的，是大型雲端服務商(CSP)的自主研發計畫：

亞馬遜(AWS)：已相繼開發出用於推論與訓練的 Inferentia2 與 Trainium 晶片。
微軟(Microsoft)：今年推出 Maia 200 推論晶片，並積極規劃後續產品 Maia 300。
Meta：近兩年透過內部計畫，已陸續開發出四款自研 AI 晶片。


《Motley Fool》特別強調，大客戶的自研晶片無須在整體性能上全面超越輝達即可構成威脅。只要自研晶片具備更低的總體持有成本(TCO)且供應更穩定，雲端業者就會將部分資料中心工作負載轉向自家產品，進而縮減對外採購輝達硬體的需求。至於微軟未來是否會對外銷售 Maia 300，目前僅屬市場臆測，尚不足以認定其將直接進入通用型 GPU 市場與輝達競爭。
供應吃緊減緩後，定價權與毛利率恐面臨考驗
報導進一步指出，輝達近年居高不下的毛利率，主要源於全球 AI 硬體持續供應吃緊所帶來的強勢定價權。一旦亞馬遜、微軟與 Meta 等三大客戶逐步放量生產自研晶片，並提升內部算力自給率，整體市場供需結構將發生變化，屆時輝達的定價主導力與毛利率表現恐將承壓。
不過，《Motley Fool》也澄清，這項觀點目前仍屬於長期的潛在風險評估，並非輝達當前訂單或毛利率已出現下滑的實據。未來的戰局關鍵，將取決於各大雲端巨頭能否將自研晶片成功進行大規模商業部署，以及這些晶片最終能實質取代多少輝達設備的市場份額。

items.title: 英國第2季GDP優於預期 但經濟學家憂下半年表現
items.title_en: UK Q2 GDP Beats Expectations, but Economists Fear H2 Performance
paras: 英國國家統計局(ONS)周三(30日)公布的最新修訂數據顯示，英國第二季GDP季增 0.5%，優於先前預估與市場預期的 0.4%。
帶動成長的主力來自服務業產出季增 0.6%(其中專業、科學及技術活動成長 2.3%)，以及淨貿易大幅改善，出口量成長 2.8%。此外，實質家庭可支配所得回升 1.0%，企業投資季增 1.8%，展現上半年經濟的強勁韌性。
這些數據證實，儘管中東戰事重燃通膨壓力，但消費者在夏季仍持續消費，推動英國經濟在上半年表現遠超預期。
數據公布後，英鎊匯率擴大漲幅，一度上漲0.2%，至1.3259美元。
服務業活動的顯著擴張與出口反彈，是第2季 GDP 能超越預期的核心力道。對此數據，ONS 經濟統計主管 Liz McKeown 指出：「最新一季更強勁的服務業成長，意味著經濟規模比先前估計的稍微擴大。」
然而展望下半年，經濟學者警告，受能源價格上限調升、生活成本再度飆升以及地緣政治引發的通膨壓力影響，第三與第四季經濟成長率恐放緩至 0.2%。
對此，英國財政大臣 John Healey 承諾將在 10 月 28 日公布的預算案中，給予家庭與企業「喘息空間」。但在金融市場預期央行可能持續升息及債券市場波動下，政策調控仍面臨嚴峻挑戰。
paras_en: The UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) released revised data on Wednesday (the 30th) showing that the country's GDP grew by 0.5% quarter‑on‑quarter in the second quarter, beating the previous forecast and market expectation of 0.4%.

Growth was driven mainly by a 0.6% rise in services output (with professional, scientific and technical activities up 2.3%) and a sharp improvement in net trade, with exports up 2.8%. In addition, real disposable household income rebounded 1.0% and corporate investment rose 1.8% quarter‑on‑quarter, demonstrating strong resilience in the economy during the first half of the year.

These figures confirm that, despite renewed Middle‑East conflict adding inflationary pressure, consumers kept spending throughout the summer, pushing the UK economy’s first‑half performance well beyond expectations.
Following the data release, the pound widened its gains, briefly rising 0.2% to $1.3259.

The pronounced expansion in services activity and the export rebound were the core forces behind the second‑quarter GDP outperformance. Commenting on the data, ONS economic statistics chief Liz McKeown said, “The stronger services growth this quarter means the economy is a little larger than previously estimated.”

However, looking ahead to the second half of the year, economists warn that higher energy price caps, a resurgence in living‑cost pressures and geopolitically‑driven inflation could slow growth in the third and fourth quarters to as low as 0.2%.

In response, UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey pledged to give households and businesses “breathing space” in the budget to be presented on October 28, but with financial markets expecting the central bank may keep raising rates and bond market volatility, policy adjustments still face a tough challenge.

items.title: 美日聯合示警與升息預期發酵 日元升破157關卡 成G10最強貨幣
items.title_en: US-Japan Joint Warning and Rate Hike Expectations Fuel Yen Surge Past 157, Becomes Strongest G10 Currency
paras: 日元周三(30日)在東京匯市大幅走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破157大關，盤中一度大升0.6%至156.38日元，躍居G10中表現最強。 這波強勁反彈主要受美日當局強烈的口頭干預訊號、日央追加升息預期，以及季末企業資金回流等三大因素共同帶動。
政治與官方政策層面上，美日兩國針對日元過度貶值展現出前所未有的協調姿態。 日本財務官三村淳日前指出，美日雙方對於日元估值過低的立場共享著「極為明確」的訊息。日本首相高市早苗表示，美國總統川普在會談中直接對日元持續疲軟表達了憂慮。
日本財相片山皋月公開強調，日方將繼續與美國財長貝森特保持緊密溝通，市場解讀此舉顯示華府對日元走強的態度已從口頭支持轉向更實質的政策協調。
另一方面，貨幣政策的緊縮預期進一步為日元提供支撐。 日本央行於9月政策會議將基準利率由1%調升至1.25%後，面對全球高通膨壓力，市場押注日央最快可能在10月再次升息。
自美日兩國於7月啟動15年來首次協調干預、日本單月砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元以來，日元自接近164的低點持續反彈，本季度累計升幅已達3.5%至3.6%左右。
市場交易結構方面，三井住友信託銀行分析指出，9月底恰逢第三季季末，國內出口商大量資金本國回歸等特殊實需買盤湧現，推升了日元走勢。華僑銀行外匯策略師Moh Siong Sim表示，川普的表態強化了美日深化合作的預期，加上干預風險使市場對做空日元保持謹慎，160關卡已被市場視為官方行動的重要防線。
paras_en: The yen surged sharply on Wednesday (30th) in Tokyo’s foreign exchange market, with the USD/JPY rate falling below the 157 threshold and briefly jumping 0.6% intraday to 156.38 yen, making it the strongest performer among the G10 currencies. This strong rebound was driven by three main factors: strong verbal intervention signals from US and Japanese authorities, the Bank of Japan’s added rate‑hike expectations, and the end‑of‑quarter corporate cash repatriation.

On the political and policy front, the United States and Japan have shown an unprecedented coordinated stance against the yen’s excessive depreciation. Japanese Finance Minister Shun Miyazawa recently noted that both sides share a “very clear” message regarding the yen’s undervaluation. Prime Minister Kishida said that President Trump directly expressed concern about the yen’s continued weakness during their talks.

Japanese Finance Minister Shun Miyazawa emphasized that Japan will continue close communication with US Treasury Secretary Yellen, and markets interpret this as Washington shifting from verbal support to more substantive policy coordination on a stronger yen.

On the monetary‑policy side, tightening expectations further underpin the yen. After the Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate from 1% to 1.25% at its September policy meeting, markets, facing global high‑inflation pressure, are betting that the BOJ could hike rates again as early as October.

Since the US and Japan launched their first coordinated intervention in 15 years in July, with Japan dumping a record 15.4 trillion yen in a single month, the yen has rebounded from near a 164 low, delivering a cumulative rise of about 3.5%‑3.6% this quarter.

Regarding market trading structure, Mitsui Sumitomo Trust Bank noted that the end of September coincided with the third‑quarter quarter‑end, prompting a surge of genuine buying demand from domestic exporters repatriating large amounts of capital, which lifted the yen. OCBC’s foreign‑exchange strategist Moh Siong Sim said Trump’s remarks reinforced expectations of deeper US‑Japan cooperation, and the intervention risk has made traders cautious about shorting the yen, with the 160 level now seen as a key defensive barrier for official action.

items.title: 利差重新主導匯市！美元兌歐元9月飆升近2.5%創14個月之最　後市待PCE與非農數據裁決
items.title_en: Yield Gap Reclaims Dominance in FX Market! Dollar/Euro Soars Nearly 2.5% in September, Highest in 14 Months; Future Hinges on PCE and Non‑Farm Data
paras: 受美歐利差擴大與歐洲能源、財政隱憂的雙重驅動，美元兌歐元匯率9月累計上漲接近2.5%，創14個月來單月最大升幅，歐元兌美元周一(28日)一度貶值至1.1312美元，為2025年5月以來最低，目前仍在1.1334附近交易。
美元兌歐元這輪升勢的主線是利差，而非單一避險交易。美元強勢的背後是美國成長與利率預期相對更強，美國經濟保持韌性，市場重新提高對聯準會(Fed升息路徑的預期，高利率推升美元資產的收益率吸引力。只要美國短端和長端利率明顯高於歐洲，全球資金就更有動力持有美元債券和現金資產。
美元強勢也擴散至其他貨幣，瑞士法郎兌美元一度跌至16個半月低點，澳元則跌破0.7美元，為8月初來首見。
歐洲正同時承受能源與財政雙重壓力，基準歐洲天然氣價格9月一度上漲至2022年以來最高，能源重新成為經濟與通膨定價的重要變數；法國債市壓力也在擴大，法德公債殖利率利差升破115個基點，為2012年以來最大，進一步削弱歐元資產的相對吸引力，這正是美元上漲並非單純避險交易的關鍵證據，因歐元自身的結構性壓力，構成美元強勢的另一半支撐力量。
與此同時，Fed內部並未一致主張快速連續升息，這給美元設了上限。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯表示，9月升息後「沒有必要急於」再次行動。威廉斯表態後，兩年期美債殖利率周二(29日)下降約3.5個基點，而芝商所FedWatch最新數據顯示，市場對10月再升息機率從約71%降至50%。如果美國數據轉弱、市場持續降低10月升息機率，美歐利差進一步擴大的空間將隨之收窄。
但美元未必立即反轉。歐元本身的壓力依舊存在，當前匯率更像是美國利率優勢與歐洲基本面共同作用的結果。
Spectra Markets總裁Brent Donnelly指出，美元若要從目前水準進一步上行，需要強勁的美國數據持續提供動力。
聯準會偏好的核心PCE通膨指標將於周三(30日)出爐，週五(10月2日)還有美國非農就業報告。若就業數據持續強勁，市場可能重新提高升息預期。若PCE與非農雙雙偏強，美元可能重新測試本輪高點。
paras_en: Driven by widening US‑Euro yield differentials and Europe’s energy and fiscal worries, the dollar‑euro pair rose almost 2.5% in September, the biggest monthly gain in 14 months. The euro fell to $1.1312 on Monday the 28th – its lowest since May 2025 – and is now trading around $1.1334.

The main driver of this dollar‑euro rally is the yield gap, not a pure safe‑haven move. The dollar’s strength reflects relatively stronger US growth and rate expectations, with the US economy staying resilient. Markets have lifted expectations for the Fed’s tightening path, and higher US short‑ and long‑term rates make dollar‑denominated assets more attractive. As long as US rates stay clearly above European rates, global capital is motivated to hold dollar bonds and cash.

The dollar’s vigor also spilled over to other currencies: the Swiss franc slipped to a 16‑and‑a‑half‑month low against the dollar, and the Australian dollar fell below $0.70, a first since early August.

Europe is simultaneously grappling with dual energy and fiscal pressures. Benchmark European gas prices spiked in September to their highest level since 2022, making energy a key factor for the economy and inflation pricing again. French bond market stress is widening, with the Franco‑German sovereign yield spread breaking 115 basis points – the widest since 2012 – further eroding the relative appeal of euro assets. This structural strain on the euro, not just safe‑haven flows, underpins the dollar’s rise.

Meanwhile, the Fed is not united on rapid, consecutive hikes, putting a ceiling on the dollar. New York Fed President Williams said after the September hike there is “no need to rush” into another move. Following his comments, the two‑year Treasury yield fell about 3.5 basis points on Tuesday the 29th, and CME’s FedWatch showed the odds of a October hike slipping from roughly 71% to 50%. If US data weaken and the market keeps trimming October‑hike odds, the room for further US‑Euro yield spread expansion will narrow.
But the dollar may not reverse immediately. Euro‑specific pressures remain, and the current rate reflects a combination of US rate advantage and European fundamentals.
Spectra Markets President Brent Donnelly said that for the dollar to move higher from current levels, it will need continued strong US data to provide momentum.

The Fed‑preferred core PCE inflation reading is due on Wednesday the 30th, with the US non‑farm payroll report scheduled for Friday October 2nd. If employment data stay robust, markets may raise rate‑hike expectations again. A strong PCE and payroll report could push the dollar back to test its recent highs.

items.title: 期中選舉倒數5周！川普宣布啟動32天全美巡迴拉票行程   力保共和黨國會兩院多數
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: 5 Weeks Left! Trump Announces 32-Day Nationwide Campaign Tour to Boost Republican Majorities in Both Chambers
paras: 美國總統川普週二(29日)在白宮外證實，11月3日期中選舉前將展開為期32天全美競選巡迴，親赴多州為共和黨候選人助陣，首站包括本週的德州、俄亥俄州。川普此舉把總統本人與執政表現直接綁上國會兩院控制權保衛戰。
川普啟動全美「拉票」的背景是油價與海外伊朗雙線承壓。《路透社》報導指出，汽油價格持續墊高家庭成本，選民對生活支出不滿；同時白宮今年大量資源投入對伊朗政策與外交安全事務，中東局勢膠著成選戰辯論焦點。
近來，川普公開淡化油價與伊朗帶來的政治壓力，稱共和黨候選人「都希望我去助選」，並否認有同黨人士刻意保持距離。
這波巡迴啟動時間晚於顧問原先規劃。白宮官員透露，因伊朗衝突、聯合國大會及相關安全事務佔據多數時間，催票排程被壓後，直至選前倒數五週才全速推進。
川普受訪時未公布全部行程，僅確認多州接力，目標是用其支持者動員能力鞏固紅州與搖擺州出票人數。
不過，共和黨候選人態度並不完全一致。部分競選團隊歡迎總統站台，盼川普基本盤拉升募款與造勢，部分選區則更強調地方就業、稅務、治安與個人政績，避免被全國化爭議綁架。
根據路透民調，民主黨在若干眾院關鍵選區勢頭不弱，並在參院多個席次形成拉鋸。若高油價與伊朗政策持續發酵，可能影響獨立選民取向。
後續看點在於川普巡迴節奏與候選人策略如何對接：一方面以「總統牌」凝聚保守動員，另一方面避免將地方選情全盤變成對伊朗行動與能源價格的公投。若共和黨保住兩院，川普剩餘任期推動稅務、能源、移民與國防案將會更順，但失去眾院或參院多數，行政部門將面對更強立法牽制與聽證調查壓力。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed on Tuesday (the 29th) outside the White House that he will launch a 32‑day nationwide campaign tour before the November 3 midterm elections, personally visiting multiple states to support Republican candidates, with the first stops this week in Texas and Ohio. Trump’s move directly ties his own presidency to the fight to defend control of both chambers of Congress.

The backdrop for Trump’s nationwide "vote‑getting" push is pressure from both rising oil prices and the Iran issue abroad. Reuters reported that gasoline prices are continuously raising household costs, fueling voter dissatisfaction with living expenses; at the same time the White House has poured substantial resources this year into Iran policy and diplomatic security matters, making the stalemate in the Middle East a focal point of election debate.

Recently, Trump has publicly downplayed the political pressure from oil prices and Iran, saying Republican candidates "all want me to campaign for them" and denying that any party members are deliberately keeping their distance.

The tour’s start was later than advisors originally planned. White House officials said that the Iran conflict, the United Nations General Assembly and related security issues occupied most of the time, pushing back the voter‑mobilization schedule until the final five weeks before the election, when it was accelerated at full speed.

Trump did not disclose the full itinerary in the interview, only confirming a relay of stops across multiple states, aiming to use his supporter‑mobilization ability to cement vote totals in red states and swing states.

However, Republican candidates are not uniformly aligned. Some campaign teams welcome the president’s appearances, hoping Trump will boost fundraising and rally the base, while other districts emphasize local jobs, taxes, public safety and personal achievements to avoid being hijacked by national controversies.

According to a Reuters poll, Democrats are showing solid momentum in several key House districts and are engaged in tight races for multiple Senate seats. If high oil prices and Iran policy continue to evolve, they could sway independent voters.

The next focus will be how the rhythm of Trump’s tour aligns with candidate strategies: on one hand using the "president brand" to rally conservative voters, on the other avoiding turning every local contest into a referendum on Iran actions and energy prices. If Republicans retain both chambers, Trump’s remaining term could see smoother progress on tax, energy, immigration and defense legislation; losing the House or Senate majority would subject the administration to stronger legislative checks and heightened hearing investigations.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】RBA升息一碼，無助澳幣跌勢
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA Raises Rates by One Point, Does Not Help Aussie Dollar Decline

美國總統川普拒絕德黑蘭停火協議，市場懷疑結束伊朗衝突的新努力能否成功，激發油價回升，而且美國強勁的經濟勢頭加劇通貨膨脹擔憂，促使美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)將大幅加息的預期升溫，推動美國公債收益率上升，其中對匯率影響比長期債券更重要的兩年期收益率升至兩年來最高，逼近具象徵意義的5%關口，週二提振美元；此外，日本7月領先指標向下修正至1.5，但日本財務大臣片山皋月稱，上周與美國財政部長貝森特通電話時明確向對方表示，首相高市早苗非再通貨膨脹主義者，並將繼續與美國財政部保持密切溝通，確保外匯市場有序運行，干預的疑慮支撐日圓，美元兌日圓自157.71高點下滑。

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 101.40, the highest level since July 28.
The dollar also stayed near multi‑month highs against other major currencies. The 10‑year US Treasury yield, after hitting its highest level since June 2007, settled above 5%.
Investors continue to watch the risk of oil‑supply disruptions from the Middle‑East conflict, keeping Brent crude trading above $100 a barrel.

The dollar rose 0.17% against the Swiss franc, to 0.834 franc.

Corpay market strategist Karl Schamotta wrote in a note to investors, “The widening interest‑rate differential is dominating the FX market, pushing the dollar higher against all major currencies and catching market forecasters off guard.”

Brent crude futures fell 2.56% to $102.59 a barrel.

Markets are simultaneously digesting remarks from Fed officials.
New York Fed President John Williams said the Fed still has time to assess economic data before deciding when to raise rates again.
Fed Governor Michael Barr on Tuesday again offered reasons to support further rate hikes.
After those comments were released, traders appeared to lower expectations for a rate hike at the Fed’s next meeting. Futures now imply about a 52% chance of a hike, down from 70% the day before.

The Australian dollar fell 0.43% against the US dollar, to $0.69888, near a two‑month low.

paras: 日本央行本月將政策利率調升至 1.25%，創下 31 年來新高，然而日元匯率未升反貶，美元兌日元一度衝破 158 關卡。主因在於美國聯準會重啟升息，使美日利差依舊顯著，加上日銀以 7 比 2 的表決結果決議升息，未達市場預期的鷹派立場，反而放大了市場拋售日元的壓力。
有些人認為，即使日本當局干預外匯市場，也無法保證日元持續走強。瑞銀資產管理全球主權及貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，如果日本當局再次出手捍衛日元，他將藉此機會拋售日元。
他指出，儘管市場預期日本央行明年6月前將升息至多3次，但聯準會同期也預計升息3次。 「如果聯準會降息時美元兌日元匯率都沒有下跌，那麼聯準會升息時又怎麼可能大幅下跌呢？」
在長期低利率環境下，全球「日元套利交易」規模已劇烈膨脹。根據統計，跨境日元借款規模在過去3年半大增 67%，達到 360 兆日元(約 2.3 兆美元)。投資人與機構法人借入低利日元後，轉而投入高殖利率的美元資產與美股市場，藉此賺取利差與匯差回報。
這股巨大的套利資金已成為全球金融市場的潛在「平倉火藥桶」。日銀目前面臨極大的政策兩難：若升息節奏過慢，利差誘因將讓套利交易持續擴大；但若升息過快引發日元急升，將觸發投資人為止損而大量賣出海外資產並買回日元，引發連鎖平倉潮。
2024 年夏天日銀意外升息時，就曾導致日經指數單日暴跌 12.4%，衝擊全球股市。瑞銀策略師James Malcolm估計，當時美元兌日元套息交易的峰值規模至少為5000億美元，其中約2000億美元在兩到三周內進行了平倉。他解釋說：「決定平倉規模的並非利差的絕對水準，而是利差變化的速度。」
paras_en: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% this month, a 31‑year high, but the yen fell instead of rising, with the dollar‑yen pair briefly breaking the 158 level. The main reason is the Fed’s resumption of rate hikes, keeping the US‑Japan yield gap sizable, and the BOJ’s 7‑to‑2 vote to raise rates fell short of market‑expected hawkishness, amplifying pressure to sell the yen.

Some argue that even if Japanese authorities intervene in the FX market, they cannot guarantee a sustained yen rally. Kevin Zhao, head of global sovereign and currency fixed‑income at UBS Asset Management, said that if the authorities step in to defend the yen, he would use the chance to sell the currency.

He noted that while markets expect the BOJ to hike up to three times before June next year, the Fed is also projected to raise rates three times in the same period. “If the dollar‑yen rate doesn’t fall when the Fed cuts, how could it drop sharply when the Fed hikes?”

In a prolonged low‑rate environment, the global “yen carry‑trade” has ballooned. Statistics show cross‑border yen borrowing has surged 67% over the past three‑and‑a‑half years to 360 trillion yen (about $2.3 trillion). Investors and institutional entities borrow cheap yen and invest in higher‑yielding dollar assets and US equities, earning both interest‑rate and currency‑exchange returns.

This massive arbitrage flow has become a potential “liquidation powder keg” for world markets. The BOJ now faces a stark policy dilemma: if rate hikes are too slow, the yield differential will keep expanding carry‑trade volumes; if hikes are too fast and the yen spikes, investors may rush to unwind overseas positions and buy back yen, triggering a cascade of liquidations.

When the BOJ unexpectedly raised rates in the summer of 2024, the Nikkei plunged 12.4% in a single day, rattling global equity markets. UBS strategist James Malcolm estimated that at the time the peak size of the dollar‑yen carry‑trade was at least $500 billion, with roughly $200 billion unwound within two to three weeks. He explained, “The scale of unwindings is driven not by the absolute level of the spread but by the speed of its change.”
